_** **_ Fellow Conservative,

I’m unsure if you’re aware, but tomorrow marks the final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of Montana’s June 4th primary. And quite frankly, I hoped to be in a better spot.

Why?

Because getting dollars in the door this month has been tough. My finance team tells me it’s typical for fundraising to begin taking off as Election Day draws nearer, but that hasn’t happened for us. For a while, things seem to be sorting themselves out. We raised a decent amount of money in March and April, but once May rolled around, our numbers went downhill.

**But don’t take my word for it. I made the chart above to show how dramatically our fundraising has fallen off.**
[**CHIP IN $3 ->** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=eb54737975774d549e7cfdd2fe0a86b5&_e=57CG4xjUqUuLHco-JIk6rN17olihl64VMrM8vyqgxFsNxkHkrUJ24J0FkPIkrSf2_FldSI68J56Z2Gij_iKzC-IZG91cVXYnp109At99ixyxIWcexRbEb3hvxBSDgL6fytYZMjLeJCjiaQjEGPLEr3q1fcok178Oc2K1kVDa8OuEXbtjErSSdVvXbcIpzG2eiHkaYHJz9YU9WXHTX5LkCa4jphty9WOt3u5YxfeqemGQ5SDYSmJ17F1cc38JPkQRDlxQRKI6__bpDKTdt20UEzJmVmoP4dhBDMsQweaY-3ricXZyta7bVWb_rFg3EDhPYgXJLgRDYobKXL8bFMBiq7-vnRxofF324JUvFm6c-qsqpznM093kOtcdynmI0flVfyB4HuIsalDn5q1lpg0Tdz6DiiJfgTHqFtSGITcC6bA%3D)
Each value in the chart above represents how much my team raised in the first 15 days of each month so far in 2024.

Things were on the up and up through March , then we began to slide backward.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

* When we missed our April fundraising goal, I emailed our list of supporters, explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1 and is regularly outraised by my opponent five to one. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say say that request fell short is an understatement. **My plea for help raised just $931. ->[link to donate](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=eb54737975774d549e7cfdd2fe0a86b5&_e=57CG4xjUqUuLHco-JIk6rN17olihl64VMrM8vyqgxFsNxkHkrUJ24J0FkPIkrSf2_FldSI68J56Z2Gij_iKzC-IZG91cVXYnp109At99ixyxIWcexRbEb3hvxBSDgL6fytYZMjLeJCjiaQjEGPLEr3q1fcok178Oc2K1kVDa8OuEXbtjErSSdVvXbcIpzG2eiHkaYHJz9YU9WXHTX5LkCa4jphty9WOt3u5YxfeqemGQ5SDYSmJ17F1cc38JPkQRjX6VYSQrGFWRgS9TsSp9JK9qy0pu7b_0C3vJBnBkAD9EXaPofIWmISyxuQs2MLbdTqtU54ooT2t2wr64SwiORnHDo6nlPauN1py1Ju597rgUhAnFDUpHMGKhRwhFoyj-FscWvL28lVCEevpAM540VOTr2g_Lyn7j7nMhLKIoeIQ%3D) **

* We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

* Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. Jacky Rosen, Jon Tester, and Sherrod Brown are in the fights of their lives to win reelection, and it’s critical that they do. Democrats’ ability to defend our Senate majority hinges on these races. We cannot overemphasize how important it is that Democrats hold the Senate majority. Under Democrats’ Senate majority, we’ve made so much incredible progress over the last few years: making a historic investment in our country’s infrastructure, enshrining federal protections for LGBTQI+ and interracial marriage into law through the Respect for Marriage Act , passing the most significant gun safety legislation in decades, expanding health care and benefits to our country’s veterans through the PACT Act , and more. For too long, Washington DC has failed our young people and Congress has REFUSED to take action to stop the radical Left’s indoctrination - and now, we’re paying the price.

| | Peter, it’s official: I just won the Democratic primary here in Maryland and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November. Our race here proved once and for all that the power of money does not outweigh the power of _people_. Despite my opponent's historic spending, we were able to show the true power of our grassroots coalition thanks to your support. Now the hard work begins, because we just have 7 months to win this seat and help Democrats maintain control of the Senate. But it won’t be easy, Peter. Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have made Maryland a top target and have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat us. So, I need your immediate support to have resources to fight back. **We have a lot to accomplish now that the primary is the rearview, which is why we’ve set a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week.[Will you chip in a grassroots donation right now to become a General Election Founding Donor to help us defeat Larry Hogan?](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/24846?t=11&amount=25&akid=1664%2E52803%2ED2Hbke)** | | | [Become a General Election Founding Donor!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/24846?t=12&amount=25&akid=1664%2E52803%2ED2Hbke)

As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families.
And yet, when we announced our campaign for the U.S. Senate, I heard the same question I’ve heard my entire career:
_But is she tough enough?_
Together, this grassroots team answered that question the same way we always do.
_Huge, ambitious fundraising goals?_ **We crushed them.**
_A lot of Marylanders who were undecided?_ **We spoke with those voters.**
_Over $65 million spent on ads against our campaign?_ **We shrugged it off, dug in our heels, and outmaneuvered their spending at every turn.**

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z945arsi3cc06beintd3el1nb29lo4hmi1t1cjr8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmcor0cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zs7l04h5pbmhksl62sri8gig0dr964boorcslfqg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmcor0cjh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm1q70r0r51do3qf935i2l2n4e3p8gj4503a87ko_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmcor0cjh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsibtgiandnfsgav8c0po60j1754esctn7f9goao_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmeoj3cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3nj29vlpg2dp93kl9bd4sdilq029p58a5j25ju8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmeoj3cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbp1atjfr26825cd2o84gm9t3csp4tmimlausgm0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmeoj3cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

body:
The Virginia Budget Passed. What you need to know.
| | | |
VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION
BUDGET DEAL PASSED MONDAY
WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW

---
|
---
| | [LISTEN LIVE TO 1140 WRVA](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018Hm42CcEmAAl95eg5zPFEs54MlfQo4VX1IUJFrN-Tzdu6rOekxwFi_LV4l5_SsrZy5v6cZFcBXtEqt_ldfAplcYTn3pV1xTSZH4l7iDnDuahTF4dhR8YSpObJhoX_oZ7SY_IGGQmAfWZaz2Nu7qK2nuX9yheBcfiEWsUt7i8lXJ41WBqQRo3HGuHWSzyLlVn5P2AYDRsMRzsY10cBrBtTQ==&c=sJHxx_0fWg9eoZK1GZbQ17c_PQu4izDPsPh_nj4-_h_abnV2w7d6UA==&ch=ws6sNlGbLlZbWsOS2s3cy6F4StYMtzSqbJVYkkwDTZauuGlUHwUISA==)
---
---
|
# TUNE IN WED, MAY 16 at 7:05AM
---
| Friends, If I had a vote on Virginia's budget on Monday, I would have voted "no." Why?
Way too much spending.
Why isn't anyone talking about how much spending the General Assembly has voted to increase the budget year after year to the tune of a whopping $20 billion over the past 4 years? That's a 20% increase. Wow.
While I understand the challenges of inflation, especially under Biden, it's time to ask legislators why they keep voting for budgets with out of control spending.
Just take a look at Virginia's operating expenses alone which for perspective were almost $38 billion in FY2010. They increased to $67 billion in FY2021 and now the budget that was approved on Monday at $87.5 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026.
Are you kidding me?
It's time to re-evaluate and re-prioritize all of the spending of our taxpayer dollars and look at ways to trim programs that aren't constitutionally mandated and are a waste of taxpayer dollars.
The Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year FY2025-2026 budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. That's $87 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026, almost a $20 billion or 20% increase in 4 years.
The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate.
A huge kudos and thank you to the unsung heroes who voted "no" on this bloated budget full of increased spending.
That said, we had to have a budget so our state wouldn't face a shutdown, which would have taken place on July 1, 2024. Yes, I hear you. There are agencies in the state government that I would like to see shut down as well, but there are also core functions of government that we must fund or it will effect public safety.
The reality is that the legislature is controlled by Democrats who like to spend and love governmental subsidized programs and subsidies. So Governor Youngkin and Republicans had to compromise. The governor didn't get the tax cuts he so strongly advocated for but thankfully there were also no new tax increases.
So here's the good news. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget.
Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026.
The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills.
There's much controversy over the operation of skill games in Virginia. While many small businesses and convenience stores say they desperately need these profits to stay afloat, many like myself are concerned about families and the addiction that entraps so many low income at risk families who are desperate to escape poverty, only to find they lose more money than they gain, further leaving the most vulnerable even more destitute. For reasons that I don't understand, this issue alone is a very heated debate and hot topic that has reached new heights in the General Assembly. Go figure. I don't get it.
The budget scrapped nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025 and ticked off many convienience store owners. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia.
Of all of the issues facing Virginians I can't figure out for the life of me why this single issue seems to have become one of the hottest issues that is before the General Assembly.
The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget. Why? So they can further debate and discuss how to handle skill games in Virginia. I can personally think of many higher priority issues, but it does appear the General Assembly will return to rehash skill games.
I personally don't believe it's worth bringing legislators back to Richmond for the sole purpose of addressing skill games in Virginia. In my humble opinion, it can wait until the 2025 legislative session in January.
By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to discuss potentially giving all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction. Another reason, the General Assembly should not meet again until January. More taxes on Virginians could be passed.
It concerns me that even some Republicans are interested in raising taxes locally to cover school construction. If a locality is struggling, then taxing the people in that area will only make matters worse. Instead cut some of these well intended commemorative programs and celebrations and let's find money in the budget to help these struggling schools.
---
|
---
The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees.
We're facing a major teacher shortage in Virginia, so I support doing anything to attract and retain good teachers. That said, where is the money in education going? Is it in fact going to teachers?
It increases state funding of K-12 schools by more than $2 billion and provides more than $200 million to make higher education more affordable by curbing tuition increases.
The approved budget boosts spending for Medicaid and rates paid to personal care attendants and expands services for Virginians with behavioral health disabilities.
The deal provides almost $145 million for the Washington transit system, $100 million in toll relief for drivers in Hampton Roads and, contingent on additional revenue, $175 million for improvements to Interstate 81 in western Virginia.
Why not get rid of the tolls in Hampton Roads? No wonder the people of Hampton need relief. You can't travel 10 miles before you have to pay a toll in Hampton. Does it surprise you that the city of Hampton is controlled by Democrats who voted in favor of the tolls? Sounds like a mismanagement issue to me. Maybe a call to Senators Louis Lucas and Maime Locke would be a good start. To support toll roads and then ask for relief is backwards to say the least.
Finally, the legislature elected eight judges, including three from [Hanover County, David Caddell Jr. ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018Hm42CcEmAAl95eg5zPFEs54MlfQo4VX1IUJFrN-Tzdu6rOekxwFi_LV4l5_SsrZiOm2lE2tfPK-03avezYtVblLuO7d1W0SaElz4G7VlNRz7k2WA1eEKFHZ7DbAurvcijVicwz4d-iJNRVr8KwclvA2a0UKBw_3jkiTJh6eh9DXSzZk1Ww_eQ==&c=sJHxx_0fWg9eoZK1GZbQ17c_PQu4izDPsPh_nj4-_h_abnV2w7d6UA==&ch=ws6sNlGbLlZbWsOS2s3cy6F4StYMtzSqbJVYkkwDTZauuGlUHwUISA==)and [Robert Reibach](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018Hm42CcEmAAl95eg5zPFEs54MlfQo4VX1IUJFrN-Tzdu6rOekxwFi_LV4l5_SsrZMQPGYIyZyWJs0JSUUdoxinzpiB5vWim7RqqBAmNR5tCZiP-nxIHZKfM3KDb9tcCE_FQ31plQ5dCzA5OQduqXvFv9jQeY39tjTxdZwfykZu05jZWPizAKlw==&c=sJHxx_0fWg9eoZK1GZbQ17c_PQu4izDPsPh_nj4-_h_abnV2w7d6UA==&ch=ws6sNlGbLlZbWsOS2s3cy6F4StYMtzSqbJVYkkwDTZauuGlUHwUISA==), for eight year terms on the circuit court for the 15th Judicial District; and Lisa Sewell, for a six-year term on the juvenile and domestic relations court for the 15th District.

What you need to know. | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION BUDGET DEAL PASSED MONDAY WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW | | | == | TUNE IN WED, MAY 16 at 7:05AM | Friends, If I had a vote on Virginia's budget on Monday, I would have voted "no." Why? Way too much spending. Why isn't anyone talking about how much spending the General Assembly has voted to increase the budget year after year to the tune of a whopping $20 billion over the past 4 years? That's a 20% increase. Wow. While I understand the challenges of inflation, especially under Biden, it's time to ask legislators why they keep voting for budgets with out of control spending. Just take a look at Virginia's operating expenses alone which for perspective were almost $38 billion in FY2010. They increased to $67 billion in FY2021 and now the budget that was approved on Monday at $87.5 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026. Are you kidding me? It's time to re-evaluate and re-prioritize all of the spending of our taxpayer dollars and look at ways to trim programs that aren't constitutionally mandated and are a waste of taxpayer dollars. The Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year FY2025-2026 budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. That's $87 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026, almost a $20 billion or 20% increase in 4 years. The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate. A huge kudos and thank you to the unsung heroes who voted "no" on this bloated budget full of increased spending. That said, we had to have a budget so our state wouldn't face a shutdown, which would have taken place on July 1, 2024. Yes, I hear you. There are agencies in the state government that I would like to see shut down as well, but there are also core functions of government that we must fund or it will effect public safety. The reality is that the legislature is controlled by Democrats who like to spend and love governmental subsidized programs and subsidies. So Governor Youngkin and Republicans had to compromise. The governor didn't get the tax cuts he so strongly advocated for but thankfully there were also no new tax increases. So here's the good news. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget. Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026. The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills. There's much controversy over the operation of skill games in Virginia. While many small businesses and convenience stores say they desperately need these profits to stay afloat, many like myself are concerned about families and the addiction that entraps so many low income at risk families who are desperate to escape poverty, only to find they lose more money than they gain, further leaving the most vulnerable even more destitute. For reasons that I don't understand, this issue alone is a very heated debate and hot topic that has reached new heights in the General Assembly. Go figure. I don't get it. The budget scrapped nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025 and ticked off many convienience store owners. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia. Of all of the issues facing Virginians I can't figure out for the life of me why this single issue seems to have become one of the hottest issues that is before the General Assembly. The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget. Why? So they can further debate and discuss how to handle skill games in Virginia. I can personally think of many higher priority issues, but it does appear the General Assembly will return to rehash skill games. I personally don't believe it's worth bringing legislators back to Richmond for the sole purpose of addressing skill games in Virginia. In my humble opinion, it can wait until the 2025 legislative session in January. By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to discuss potentially giving all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction. Another reason, the General Assembly should not meet again until January. More taxes on Virginians could be passed. It concerns me that even some Republicans are interested in raising taxes locally to cover school construction. If a locality is struggling, then taxing the people in that area will only make matters worse. Instead cut some of these well intended commemorative programs and celebrations and let's find money in the budget to help these struggling schools. | The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees. We're facing a major teacher shortage in Virginia, so I support doing anything to attract and retain good teachers. That said, where is the money in education going? Is it in fact going to teachers? It increases state funding of K-12 schools by more than $2 billion and provides more than $200 million to make higher education more affordable by curbing tuition increases. The approved budget boosts spending for Medicaid and rates paid to personal care attendants and expands services for Virginians with behavioral health disabilities. The deal provides almost $145 million for the Washington transit system, $100 million in toll relief for drivers in Hampton Roads and, contingent on additional revenue, $175 million for improvements to Interstate 81 in western Virginia. Why not get rid of the tolls in Hampton Roads? No wonder the people of Hampton need relief. You can't travel 10 miles before you have to pay a toll in Hampton. Does it surprise you that the city of Hampton is controlled by Democrats who voted in favor of the tolls? Sounds like a mismanagement issue to me. Maybe a call to Senators Louis Lucas and Maime Locke would be a good start. To support toll roads and then ask for relief is backwards to say the least. Finally, the legislature elected eight judges, including three from ==, for eight year terms on the circuit court for the 15th Judicial District; and Lisa Sewell, for a six-year term on the juvenile and domestic relations court for the 15th District. | | Dear Fellow Patriot, If you opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you. Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees... ...well, as they say, "Those were the days." But this email – isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never thought I'd be writing to you. **[Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z84vfp8cqah0515o87lo5pcv36ri8sshg34bfo4g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthmeoj3cjh2bs)** Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come. Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember. Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. _**Remember?**_ ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. _**Remember?**_ Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. subject: Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq80tgi4qdlq4kmd3jfcni2hulrkgkefpqmuqoc0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthm9o31c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7ndb62dj29uvbg4c0luvlk4efq0h31s81i56c5o_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthm9o31c3h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z06c6pv3gvvms9k0382165cns9o0ssb09g3dqpj0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35cthm9o31c3h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## Biden Hits China with New Tariffs
President Biden announced steep tariff increases Tuesday on a range of Chinese products, including quadrupling the tariff on [Chinese electric cars to 100%](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAQRp8Gd1gwMMZbUNzG3d42peWfYT0RCytDFuXtI6dO90mfjo50Pu7zfeHI6fF_eZKvIc_LVvlNM0qNEuxsu90HIiDTkddOo3ODQdUdfg9hHDSZ1Rltbg7sjivA4PToAAcHHXtQYBVqVCMOFvtbQMARdEC8IZggrKKdaz77z8ypHhTid37T2W_52UV_1PoqwvwTMAmYWmv9tpZErVy_gOmaAqaVd0qyZrmklL_SRjJRk1opWZeTQygyJ7kdnKiQpPeFdKffX41j5DI4YdXjuXD8tdY_G_wEAAD__1b3XEQ), effectively doubling their price. The tariffs will also impact Chinese-made batteries, solar cells, medical products, semiconductors, steel, and aluminum. Biden's plan keeps tariffs [put in place by former President](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL_y2yAQhJ8GdWjg4CypoEijzmlTajA6rIvRnwFsjd8-o9S_ZrfYLb75_tynu-fE2_O3X8nVuE8-VP7QhFKjBDvZZnaRCMg05HSnsetuBlWzuNkYnAcVIA4KQGOnTG_CMGiNfR-sbdiBAqtQo-rxZrEdIgL2oCPigGCisIpmrntu_-681YVi-u4fym3Y1ya5pdajCPNLwChgPM-zzfSulMu1CxhXn19Ui4DxfcWDZ9pkWXw-0lcu_KIi30VWnznGIh-cEu9bkWHhjQpdfRQZfC7y4pQKpbYCxia7-Tivd7l1wqrn6jn9R6o_CvoXAAD__2SRZdM) Donald Trump while ratcheting up others. China immediately vowed retaliation and said it would take measures to defend its interests. The new tariffs affect $18 billion in imported Chinese goods.
## Trump Team Takes Aim at Cohen
Lawyers for former President Donald Trump began their [cross examination of Michael Cohen Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ogWzJpQULwmXV57pbWBJeaEjQUkUf7-lKuvHE0zmq_rcqWU037_Txu7HstCvqcnLygkCqUXPQYXmRVPIztpJBozTwjj6m4etQXvrQlgLfmZAUBqY0metZE8JqdAaUCJcMZZ48lGVHhWMiJaVFMcNHBIvdTTd0l7Xznmd3lyPfmyjdmtvR9tmP4N6jKoCx07v9pHfaD25DMP6tLrYztEr4my8GXlXayPtoqt7PwWrZe6vUWgPXFuwkxIFGKQnkEiA97IInoFE9k5yttYXTheKefUZjNouG-U8m9M_3PNTwAAAP__fl5j-A), wasting no time peppering Cohen with questions about posting insulting comments about Trump. Trump's lawyers questions teased out [the disgraced former attorney's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGnwQ5HFla0oEhjd2lTOhws52ZQHOXOubfPJHXqv_hnvq_bfPOceXt8-pVcTWX2ofKLZpQKJZjZNNElIiDdkFNWobW9xq5ZXBh677W-d8N9VKCtiSFGHJMdlbdp8A076MB0qLAbsDfYjgkBB1AJcUTQSZiOItdytN-Ft7pQyu_yoqMNZW2yW2rdT6E_BEwCpuu62nA_N7rO3y5gyvwi-dyjr3QKmFYOi6csQ1lok_V4rrusB_ssK52V17K9ZfRvCQKm5nBxvzhnPnsrTPdYPee_bf0X4ScAAP__6rBemw) personal and financial interests. | Peter, In an era when the core values of our great nation drive us toward greater heights, **I am thrilled to invite you to a live virtual event, "The American Prosperity Blueprint," co-hosted by yours truly, Bill Spadea.** **Mark your calendars for an unforgettable evening next Tuesday, May 21st, at 8 PM Eastern.** [**Click here to secure your spot now!**](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/1a525bffcf807810bdbccf7c9c47aa80/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnCVxs4s3kQjRPESdY1mnGtJ1WcfMxP_e9kGngs7zvM_LOyMwaqk5LSGCK9-EmIMHFhUZQs1Jo1mq51UswmAeeFCRPq9s0xmIxq_hD_BMiVB4wINBh2w3cZKlxWqfp0XmSCOt6_jTI8KPZ7mO0xym6acYa-LlxblbiNh2-FhUklvFO1s5_sRs2sj3-76foSF1IFevSFYtW8l4JGxnqqn9Wg7OJo1BXb5fkeHwck53SvNoBA==) Why This Event? Why Now? As patriots, we understand that financial freedom is the backbone of the American Dream. In today’s world, the wealthy have mastered secrets of wealth preservation and growth—secrets they often keep from the average American. Together with financial strategist Rob Gill, we're tearing down these barriers to share with you the powerful strategies that foster true economic independence. What You Will Learn:
* **Proven Wealth Strategies:** Master the techniques that the financially successful use to thrive, even in uncertain times.
* **Tax Mastery:** Learn how to navigate the complexities of taxes to keep more of your hard-earned money.
* **Building a Lasting Legacy:** Strategies to ensure your financial freedom benefits not just you, but future generations.

---
|
---
Prepare for an evening that promises not only to enlighten but also to inspire action. Bring your vision for a prosperous future, your questions, and a readiness to engage. **Together, we will chart the course for a prosperous America, starting with our own financial independence.**

| Did you see this previous message from Bill? In case you missed it, check it out now: I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing the incredible kindness and generosity that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey. Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, something remarkable happened. Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. This act of kindness not only provided Penny with much-needed relief but also sparked a new friendship that warmed all our hearts.
When my wife Jodi and I visited Penny's home to witness the installation, we were deeply moved by the generosity extended by Ryan and his team. Not only did they donate the system and labor, but they also paid Penny's HOA fees for the entire year—an extraordinary gesture of compassion and solidarity. This moment reminded me once again why New Jersey is such a special place. When it comes to rallying around those in need, New Jerseyans stand out as the epitome of kindness and generosity. This is precisely what the Common Sense Club holds near and dear to its heart—making New Jersey a better place for all New Jerseyans. It's about extending a helping hand, fostering connections, and embodying the values of compassion and community. I invite you to watch the video of our meeting with Penny for the first time, and I hope it inspires you as much as it has inspired me. With gratitude, Bill

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-MyLhFBHgtTXkN0rdDqlOw~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-MyLhFBHgtTXkN0rdDqlOw~~/AARclAA~~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/-MyLhFBHgtTXkN0rdDqlOw~~/AARclAA~~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Restore Our Nation
---

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=502f4d9255db458885c3b021faf7aeb5&_e=6JLItmCMhMmmY6ajeZPgpKkseoIxNG_pydMV-eVYbC5ubnpH2O8jvawzb6kAbe7YA_udlh9D0P1E8eW5ZxRHiHwW9eYYS4hjrKJAtJ0JixkKBGnAneMpwoL9keh91KZeSVZRH3J6_KjlMKXugh5MQmRtThak2POo3m_1zl4bRdB4JvJ3w9gqdhNtT2d7L7xJV0WLhbrMVpTUv0ZaWm1P5Kocg5T_2iFmWwzdhx0A6zI5SOkAWljQiDT7HX05alWWgePzPxUEoslpgXHJxj3FrwJWeQkdIf54S1Tk18ktulhnWnhsJQZIsrIIEYP3KHcOK5IhqZQ5Fu880cHVYVwgCrQVHHIGmiLNJobL-fSGJBVYSln9-_O8FWjxGJxabFRKBAzqEsuZ1D8Zuvq1jhix6g%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=502f4d9255db458885c3b021faf7aeb5&_e=6JLItmCMhMmmY6ajeZPgpKkseoIxNG_pydMV-eVYbC5ubnpH2O8jvawzb6kAbe7YA_udlh9D0P1E8eW5ZxRHiHwW9eYYS4hjrKJAtJ0JixkKBGnAneMpwoL9keh91KZeSVZRH3J6_KjlMKXugh5MQmRtThak2POo3m_1zl4bRdB4JvJ3w9gqdhNtT2d7L7xJV0WLhbrMVpTUv0ZaWm1P5Kocg5T_2iFmWwzdhx0A6zI5SOkAWljQiDT7HX05alWWUsMqXn0UXdgLOr6ruJE2N8LMb5KLN2fb18R7ohvhYQlvoqw6B4EZwzIC0Cfpj0RhtSICkfQFXwU7ep5INoJm5P353_zs_Qtg0IckYTS6Gj3fv4DhfU2UAmcCoCubx1felnaYhVnazhwpzE9qLfO0CA%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=502f4d9255db458885c3b021faf7aeb5&_e=6JLItmCMhMmmY6ajeZPgpKkseoIxNG_pydMV-eVYbC5ubnpH2O8jvawzb6kAbe7YA_udlh9D0P1E8eW5ZxRHiHwW9eYYS4hjrKJAtJ0JixkKBGnAneMpwoL9keh91KZeSVZRH3J6_KjlMKXugh5MQmRtThak2POo3m_1zl4bRdB4JvJ3w9gqdhNtT2d7L7xJV0WLhbrMVpTUv0ZaWm1P5Kocg5T_2iFmWwzdhx0A6zI5SOkAWljQiDT7HX05alWWnWtZNH-hUnPbAQHf7nGe6z-N4URQLLVYVj4xc44w4vUH_nNXl5XF-_roA0x7ihVOR6o3Sz1CpykWBMEVWCeShpnneJsNCnM_bkvk7npKWKbwY7MRqHmnEy4EsjkWwVVDdhI_17cOsLSC4_-PVMwTQg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another. I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America. You remember what it was like: ► Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. **_Remember?_** ► Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. _**Remember?**_ ► Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. _**Remember?**_ Democrat policies had brought America to its knees. And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again." There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us." But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... **_We_ _Republicans_ pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. ** **We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.** **And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.** **_We_ _can_ _do_ _that_ _again._** **It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.** **But there's no way I can pull it off without you.** [**That's why I'm asking you to rush back your _Garvey for Senate_ contribution of $35 or more right away. **](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7ec1ed9dca9847219444505125363aa2&_e=KKsZ2Q0T_ZX5Sm7DHQ-jDVa9s3oqwARTd9aA3dnPsQUHhhYX1BG53cnPLpLuC23wk0p0ued6KSN5lCoSMrEyJkhhq3KE_n4VV3Tz1FdMPLUa_f5TiuhO22l3p0mg7eMG03JrxB5Q4IcDGOCBzJl4BDG2-8obidkNIO5ZRWM-1kEdTkhyD8bmFB9oTQ1cHfJ4LdODb2-nJFRmh0XlyiSt3u4r3ryxPhl6hlkrMGp6DofB6lhaKUZGcIBTtNuk_2RFXFSyxEMqIRQgtwnL3oBbL1c2s-9NYJrAPra3GRcwCUIJNJMvXjs_7vT822zttSfWQruGAghHb75xgOY3eIK2saNkWB7Ottk7GHaAkTf_vYu6fylLMKvYPHKWMnk5dCA8gcYoBd0nimBj2a4t8zo-uA%3D%3D) I'm sorry for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away... And in that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C. That may seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the _one_ _thing_ a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we only have six months. [**When you rush your _Garvey for Senate_ campaign contribution of $35 or more... **](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7ec1ed9dca9847219444505125363aa2&_e=KKsZ2Q0T_ZX5Sm7DHQ-jDVa9s3oqwARTd9aA3dnPsQUHhhYX1BG53cnPLpLuC23wk0p0ued6KSN5lCoSMrEyJkhhq3KE_n4VV3Tz1FdMPLUa_f5TiuhO22l3p0mg7eMG03JrxB5Q4IcDGOCBzJl4BDG2-8obidkNIO5ZRWM-1kEdTkhyD8bmFB9oTQ1cHfJ4LdODb2-nJFRmh0XlyiSt3u4r3ryxPhl6hlkrMGp6DofB6lhaKUZGcIBTtNuk_2RFY7aOei6r_FLEzxbKb7QB4eRZLa0nYfQ-9bSCwqrdzlPfU0JV-hnbVigMw8uYWs1c02FtKUEBTW_jVss03iss4DvYwKhM-o59WjAIq49JYBhs3ZCB9EBdZfCwCRtWNOj4TjwWItSektDy74SrpC2ntA%3D%3D) ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: _You don't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make _all of us_ less safe, less prosperous, and less free. _ This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. When we win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the _nationwide_ Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. But listen, here's something I also want you to remember... We Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan. We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did. And America became a shining city upon a hill once more. We can do that again. It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California. But there's no way I can pull it off without you. I'm sorry for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away... And in that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C. That may seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win. Second... you know I'm not a career politician. But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California... ...name recognition. I'm no Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to President Reagan. But California voters know me. And Adam Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race. As I'm writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points separating us. We've got a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and our common sense message. ...you're helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers, EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message: You don't have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less safe, less prosperous, and less free. This race is the toughest in the nation. But they say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball. And you know I've done that plenty of times. Now I'm ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in California as a common sense Republican. But I can't do it without you. When we win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... ...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs. It all depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours. You can do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're winning for all of America. | | Thank you and God Bless, | | Steve Garvey #6 | | | P.S. It's the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun. We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the Republican Comeback Rally America needs. Thank you! \--Steve | | PAID FOR BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE PO Box 532389 Los Angeles, CA 90053-2389 | Freedom Nation Today PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

name: Hillsdale College via Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2186413367d94f2dafbe1046edba49c7&_e=GHHAoLpcgjkvi7hUN9GolmpK3_MOVJQZ1ackLgD-3cWxLjIOhSxz660UmpwtZUfgVZKoESw2Zgb_ksUk8SbRE6J8zUTxQMJkwuAJ17APDfE5TF1pts4f4n-yEGIFPGOGIkqM0Kh4eey-XcB4Kw3vSq1auc1zCpNvAMOd8sWPLR2YF_g4SCzdcgLloXl7XGsHUkjr__nxyTCLUsXTO7udXX6TBCb6Xs5xSlYL9bEFmUQI8wOrmgEc_IOqm-MnbFg7XhOMUdzc7S9vc9dZdbHzi6ctQjR2KsSal3W_TcIgy8X92W2Sij5uMSa-TZJ8DBUn4esmXiTuEpMBpjNM4YPhSkKmDXDuup6EWzlTpCASc6efa7Y7AlxWjYjgnSIXnWmuzG9Vfhvmq4LvKV-KBV-nFA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2186413367d94f2dafbe1046edba49c7&_e=GHHAoLpcgjkvi7hUN9GolmpK3_MOVJQZ1ackLgD-3cWxLjIOhSxz660UmpwtZUfgVZKoESw2Zgb_ksUk8SbRE6J8zUTxQMJkwuAJ17APDfE5TF1pts4f4n-yEGIFPGOGIkqM0Kh4eey-XcB4Kw3vSq1auc1zCpNvAMOd8sWPLR2YF_g4SCzdcgLloXl7XGsHUkjr__nxyTCLUsXTO7udXX6TBCb6Xs5xSlYL9bEFmUQI8wOrmgEc_IOqm-MnbFg7JJiVKhNI8w031CDNX8KF_siEo0pakp38GjgTAJSIkdzQkhey4vfQMN7LuSgwOpaHsZlQGoiT5NyDr5k6eEzxVKHnd6wQGfUZ_csfPnisRe9R6nxFXq6zi7lKXSERs2Pt3FRBpTSlSucUsK3LlnrRSg%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=2186413367d94f2dafbe1046edba49c7&_e=GHHAoLpcgjkvi7hUN9GolmpK3_MOVJQZ1ackLgD-3cWxLjIOhSxz660UmpwtZUfgVZKoESw2Zgb_ksUk8SbRE6J8zUTxQMJkwuAJ17APDfE5TF1pts4f4n-yEGIFPGOGIkqM0Kh4eey-XcB4Kw3vSq1auc1zCpNvAMOd8sWPLR2YF_g4SCzdcgLloXl7XGsHUkjr__nxyTCLUsXTO7udXX6TBCb6Xs5xSlYL9bEFmUQI8wOrmgEc_IOqm-MnbFg705He_lcQZKoFHAZDdNdnNgVFFkfU7-u3wIsWB_35lt8bxsJoMa77hS8CAVtpJJFu2UGbegO9wYPvP81C_S15LU5pw_JDNMybEA-dOekQrekrsS1QEK3FWaCUd0MBOigAJKJIjxMABCsWPC3nc7tEdw%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Reclaiming American Freedom

name: Bob MacGuffie
subject: The Saga of Bridgeport's Congress Street Bridge Continues
body:
Campaign Update
---
| | | | | |
---
| CAMPAIGN UPDATE
---
| | |
---
May 15, 2024 The CT Post has just provided another update on the saga of the Congress Street bridge rebuild in Bridgeport - and it's the most pitiful and illustrative indictment of the bureaucracies which deign to control our lives, that we're likely to see all year. See [CT Post - Bridge](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LudaHe7WK1iSP2C9g9KqMO8UPCbc8fLhlKWx6hZLD0oW-aB9UxSoRW0zIgXpilOQ3Ukr9_4vd7F1sfSNj0yodjWUkCiQHZ3Gl72VCSpt4Djz6hr1fWvhI0c4ay9lBR43DSlEz4kOPdhA5uKRgMoFryQcc6eAE4vioDwwzE4KdDRH4RxvZ4WC75VfRDIQqRXiplxf6W2NyFJrYhaKyrpBuO8P5rYLRzV-SsedkBYBAMqYymtCXZDNldrF9M5BeXTixPXJjATaxCTAjW6fTKMRMMSPnoXkikGWmHTALYJ0F1VnFhuHb0ImhHutezqarIvaM0LTqSUswVhS-6TBk2B2y6mkw4Nv1xEG&c=MiIeP7_tSBm7cVso2XLxwy8K1WN4NdH4Ze9gnMDx3CHi1k4ElPhraw==&ch=79UgdOZghcdMWQxDW7xx9sHmLR3BiAcrRPmEGNqElUQ2pk5WVEXqoA==)
The bridge was stuck open for over a decade when newly-minted congressman Himes famously got involved in early 2010, promising whatever officials promise to help get things moving (see below).
---
---
| Himes announcing replacement of Congress Street Bridge on 3-8-2010.
---
| A dozen years later in '22, and Himes in a heated re-election bid, did another on-site presser, and all that changed was the vertically stuck roadways were removed and the approach ramp was grassed over into a makeshift park. He again promised "shovels will be in the ground in six months." THAT never happened. But in July '23, Jim Himes in one of his favorite go-to gambits, laid the blame on others - the Democrat city hall and Bridgeport mayor Joe Ganim, with this: "I'm sitting here wondering if they're going to start construction in June of 2024, 2025? It's enormously frustrating. It's gotten to the point of embarrassment, right? I ran on this 15 years ago. And this is not a big bridge."
Lesson: A Democrat congressman and Democrat-run state and city administrations, ostensibly on the same team, are simply helpless to get the wheels of their cherished bureaucracies to turn for the benefit of the citizenry. They just can't do it. Fast forward to today, a week after a lightning-quick repair following the fiery crash on I-95 in Norwalk, and the spotlight again returns to shine on the long-abandoned bridge in the city of Bridgeport! A new bridge in Norwalk is promised within a year. But in Bridgeport, the citizens are treated to an astounding litany of bureaucratic excuses, which serve as an indictment of a Democrat government overrun and completely paralyzed by its own agencies. Local frustration has boiled over such that the City Council President, and two City Councilmen (all Democrats) have publicly roasted the City of Bridgeport, the CT Dept. of Transportation, and the U.S Dept. of Transportation. And each of these seemingly calcified agencies for years, have been operated by presumably 'friendly' Administrations of their own party! The article's re-telling of the saga of infighting between these over-authorized, over-regulating, self-interested, counter-productive bureaucracies is a thorough indictment of the big-government-knows-best model. Nothing of consequence on the public building front can be accomplished anymore, unless it gets the national media spotlight like the Francis Scott Key bridge, or the shutdown of I-95 in the heart of the northeast corridor. Over the past 15 years Mr. Himes has voted for $24 trillion of new federal debt, about $198,000 per household in our district. That includes the $1.2 trillion so-called "Infrastructure" bill of 2021. But he flails around in interviews reiterating the excuses fed to him by his own bureaucrats. He has demonstrated absolutely NO leadership on this, or any issue truly impacting the lives of his constituents. He has spent his time advancing his career by maneuvering power-plays in Washington instead. Jim Himes is always cruising around this District doing pressers, sprinkling a few bucks here and there, in even-numbered election years. But NEVER anything of consequence, like a bridge uniting two sides of the biggest city in the state. Connecticut's five congressmen and two senators, all Democrats, rank dead-last in the nation, in obtaining Federal investment in the state - merely 75-cents comes back for every dollar sent to Washington. And bringing home the Federal bacon is supposed to be a Democrat calling-card! Yes, the citizens of Connecticut have become an afterthought to these people. This country didn't get built taking orders from bureaucrats - the Greatest Generation wouldn't stand for it. The government-knows-best ideology Mr. Himes funds with our money and adheres to, has built the biggest government bureaucracy in the history of man. It has now quite obviously come to the point where it is strangling and bankrupting the communities it claims to be serving.
We need a congressman focused on actually REPRESENTING the interests of the citizenry, rather than explaining Washington's interests back to us. Enough with the word-salad Mr. Himes. Help is on the way this November.
I will make the 2024 election a referendum on Jim Himes' failed 15-year rule.
If elected I pledge to REPRESENT your individual rights, and push the regulatory state back to its rightful place, so we can move ahead with necessary public projects, and live our lives as we see fit. Please contribute to that effort right here: [Donate](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LudaHe7WK1iSP2C9g9KqMO8UPCbc8fLhlKWx6hZLD0oW-aB9UxSoRbH1paM2oEQsjXPq4CCMnCoofFcFhIxpRiwp0jHSRtI8cG1Fy30rD1ZZzrEL-PXCIT22_OLATJc6Z_G7qiReQiZw7WhB897RxhQioWAHaegC0yPHTqprIy2wbjlN8CYp11GO3QBLbfwXuigK0FovtbqF3OWqipgD6P791OVhmMZCvoDe1oLSxRo=&c=MiIeP7_tSBm7cVso2XLxwy8K1WN4NdH4Ze9gnMDx3CHi1k4ElPhraw==&ch=79UgdOZghcdMWQxDW7xx9sHmLR3BiAcrRPmEGNqElUQ2pk5WVEXqoA==)
Please re-circulate this message to any and all who are interested...or should be. Help is on the way,
Bob MacGuffie Candidate for Congress [www.BobMacforCongress.com](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LudaHe7WK1iSP2C9g9KqMO8UPCbc8fLhlKWx6hZLD0oW-aB9UxSoRb39tnIKLlh21oJnKh3fchvbsyVeV8dJJDBn-fxr6T21DmkpUjP4nmPKPTAllXPLm0FWwfFGjEmmzvvL-WnsTTFYRA8_Baqhfrc9de3wFBPZ&c=MiIeP7_tSBm7cVso2XLxwy8K1WN4NdH4Ze9gnMDx3CHi1k4ElPhraw==&ch=79UgdOZghcdMWQxDW7xx9sHmLR3BiAcrRPmEGNqElUQ2pk5WVEXqoA==)
