Jim Himes is always cruising around this District doing pressers, sprinkling a few bucks here and there, in even-numbered election years. But NEVER anything of consequence, like a bridge uniting two sides of the biggest city in the state. Connecticut's five congressmen and two senators, all Democrats, rank dead-last in the nation, in obtaining Federal investment in the state - merely 75-cents comes back for every dollar sent to Washington. And bringing home the Federal bacon is supposed to be a Democrat calling-card! Yes, the citizens of Connecticut have become an afterthought to these people. This country didn't get built taking orders from bureaucrats - the Greatest Generation wouldn't stand for it. The government-knows-best ideology Mr. Himes funds with our money and adheres to, has built the biggest government bureaucracy in the history of man. It has now quite obviously come to the point where it is strangling and bankrupting the communities it claims to be serving. We need a congressman focused on actually REPRESENTING the interests of the citizenry, rather than explaining Washington's interests back to us. Enough with the word-salad Mr. Himes. Help is on the way this November. I will make the 2024 election a referendum on Jim Himes' failed 15-year rule. If elected I pledge to REPRESENT your individual rights, and push the regulatory state back to its rightful place, so we can move ahead with necessary public projects, and live our lives as we see fit. In our country’s nearly 250 years of history, there has never been a Black doctor elected to be a voting member of Congress. I’m running to change that. And we’re running to do so much more than just make history, which I would love to expand upon below.

And we’re running to do so much more than just make history, which I would love to expand upon below. [**But my primary election is just 23 days away and my campaign manager tells me we still need to raise another $20,000 before midnight to fund one of our final voter contact campaigns. If you’re able to, I’m humbly asking if you can split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action ahead of this critical deadline.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T73841813-895d-4fe6-959f-a66c0ddad2cb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) If I’m elected, yes, we would make history and shatter a major glass ceiling. The historic nature of our campaign is not lost on me. **But I’m not running to make history. I’m running to break down barriers for the American people:** Barriers like accessing quality healthcare and a secure retirement, making reproductive care accessible to women in EVERY state, fighting to ensure everyone in our country has a fair shot at the American Dream and a social safety net that catches those who fall on hard times. _**We need more doctors in Congress**_ to fight back against GOP attempts to deny women their right to reproductive care, to block their attacks on Medicare and Medicaid, to spearhead efforts to drive down prescription drug costs, and use our expertise to reform our healthcare system so everyone can access the care their families need and deserve. But I need your help to get there Peter: **New Jersey’s 3rd Congressional District is currently open and this is a seat that Republicans used to consider a safe red seat, one they used to carry by double digits.** [**And we’ve got a budget gap to fund our next round of voter contact efforts: So can I count on you to split a donation before midnight so we have the resources to WIN this former GOP open seat?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T703d1ac4-d882-485c-a1b3-93d833a3701a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Karen Crnkovich
subject: Volunteer with Karen at the Old Shawnee Days Parade on June 8th - Sign Up Today!
body:
We are excited to kick off the parade season supporting Karen Crnkovich for U.S. Congress in the 3rd District of Kansas!

The first parade is fast approaching on the morning of Saturday, June 8th at the Old Shawnee Days Parade. Set up begins at 8:30 am and the parade begins at 10 am.

Volunteers will be walking the parade route. For those that can stay afterward, we will also be canvassing the neighborhoods. We hope you can join us!

Here is the link to sign up: <https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C084CAEA72FA3F49-49549321-march>

Thank you for everything you are doing to support the campaign!!!

Best regards,____
Team KC

Karen Crnkovich for Congress, KS03 ____
[www.kcforkansas.com](http://www.kcforkansas.com/) ____
913-414-4446
#teamkc

body:
As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we’re doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

| |

---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2tlakaapsee00pvg6st82d874h53q19bgkbdv70_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctgeeo34cdh2bs "Byron Donalds")
---

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl50f3mhmmthljge4iuq535g208npsf6bdbkj3ko_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctgeeo34cdh2bs "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdilaguclsn6ebq5bvcebo80q4ff6k88j2leu7s0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35ctgeeo34cdh2bs "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?

The Democrat Party is spending more money - and spending it earlier - than we've ever seen before. They know they are LOSING on the issues.

name: #6 Steve Garvey
subject: Are you tired?
body:
It doesn’t have to be this way
Dear Fellow American,

Are you tired of being told that everything is going fine in America today?

It's a big lie. It's a lie being told by Adam Schiff and Joe Biden (one of many) to stay in power. And it's a lie that good people like you are ALWAYS forced to pay the price for.

But it doesn't have to be that way.

Opening our borders is a **CHOICE**.

Siding with violent criminals over our brave police is a **CHOICE**.

Spending our country into an oblivion of debt and inflation is a **CHOICE**.

Allowing homelessness and addiction to render our streets and neighborhoods unsafe is a **CHOICE**.

Accepting failed public schools is a **CHOICE**.

And the ones making these "choices" for a combined 79 years in office?

_**That would be Adam Schiff and Joe Biden.**_

**Eight decades is enough.**

Heck, in my baseball days, you wouldn't be given eight innings with such pathetic performance before you'd be sent packing to the minor leagues.

Well, that's what you and I need to do to Schiff + Biden on November 5th.

They've got all the money in the world to use against us, so if you'd kindly consider making a one-time contribution of any amount to join my Garvey for Senate campaign team, it'd mean the world to me.

subject: Donald Trump wants to debate? Make my day. I’m in.

body:

---
Peter, Four years ago, Donald Trump lost two debates to me. He hasn’t shown up to one since. Now he’s acting like he wants to debate me again. Let’s do it. _Make my day, pal._ _I’ll even debate him twice._ If he decides to show up, I do have a list of things I’d like to talk to him about. I’d like to talk about how he was the architect of the repeal of _Roe v. Wade_. I’d like to talk about how he represents a core threat to our democracy. **Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Children today have it tough, between grades, drugs, alcohol--and apparently, the threat of child marriage. This isn't hyperbole. To this day in 2024, thousands of children are beholden to, obliged to, forced into, (what's the right word here?) child marriage in the United States--and Republicans seem to want to keep it that way. With several thousand documented child marriages every single year--some involving as children as young as 10--we need need legislative solutions and penalties for those who exploit children. But where do we begin? _Let 's Address This._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LHTVt45Y6A0a-_XpGCak6lj0sjwFX2_E87HPhI0BGfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144640319)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c37cc033-68e3-430e-a094-fe80f38bd699?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Passers-by are stunned by a social experiment stunt held in New York to highlight child marriage _(YouTube) via The Independent_
**First, let 's truly understand how bad this epidemic is in the United States.** Despite widespread condemnation and international treaties against it, child marriage continues in the United States unabated. As reported in numerous outlets including the Washington Post and [The Independent](https://substack.com/redirect/360408e3-5be5-457a-87ad-d6086fbaad9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> At least 207,468 minors married in the US between 2000 and 2015, according to data compiled by Unchained At Last, a group campaigning to abolish [child marriage](https://substack.com/redirect/185c64fe-19fc-4cf9-a635-8fa008631774?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and investigative documentary series Frontline. _The true figure is likely to be much higher because 10 states provided no or incomplete statistics._
> The youngest wedded were three 10-year-old girls in Tennessee who married men aged 24, 25 and 31 in 2001. The youngest groom was an 11-year-old who married a 27-year-old woman in the same state in 2006. Children as young as 12 were granted marriage licences in Alaska, Louisiana and South Carolina, while 11 other states allowed 13-year-olds to wed. More than 1,000 children aged 14 or under were granted marriage licences.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LHTVt45Y6A0a-_XpGCak6lj0sjwFX2_E87HPhI0BGfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144640319)
And the problem persists. Unchained At Last conducted another study in 2021 and found _more than 300,000_ documented cases of child marriage, as reported by [Rolling Stone](https://substack.com/redirect/96da52de-e7e4-4929-9239-8fafa7ad9aea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> A [2021 study](https://substack.com/redirect/f3058323-6c07-47b3-b098-50e968e206e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the advocacy group Unchained at Last found that 300,000 minors were married between 2000 and 2018 in the United States. According to the group, 60,000 of those marriages involved an age difference that would have otherwise been considered a sex crime.
Remember, this is yet incomplete data as 10 states do not adequately report this data. But there's yet another element of horror to this situation. In many states, children who are married cannot divorce--making child marriage a daunting one way ticket. As divorce lawyer [Nancy Zalusky Berg explains](https://substack.com/redirect/33f3e0b7-2c81-434b-b18e-98aa7a888e9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> A minor can't file for a divorce because they're not considered old enough to do it. That's because marriage is considered a contract, and most laws stipulate that only adults can enter into contracts. So, if a minor wants to change their marriage contract, they need an adult to help them do it.
**Next, let 's understand the lead culprits perpetuating this injustice.** Because while child marriage is a nationwide problem, Republican states lead the way. Nine of the top 10 states leading rates of child marriage are GOP run states. [They are as follows](https://substack.com/redirect/3400341d-91a7-4c18-a26b-595c69e18788?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> 1\. Nevada (0.671%)
> 2\. Idaho (0.338%)
> 3\. Arkansas (0.295%)
> 4\. Kentucky (0.262%)
> 5\. Oklahoma (0.229%)
> 6\. Wyoming (0.227%)
> 7\. Utah (0.208%)
> 8\. Alabama (0.195%)
> 9\. West Virginia (0.193%)
> 10\. Mississippi (0.182%)
This epidemic persists under the radar, often defended and protected by lawmakers, particularly within the Republican Party, who cite tradition, religion, and a shocking misinterpretation of maturity and readiness. The latest absurd argument is that child marriage is better than abortion--notwithstanding that states that ban abortion also [suffer at least a 24% increase in maternal mortality](https://substack.com/redirect/d9a12c3a-1c3d-429d-81bf-48afa58dcd07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and have [the highest rate of infant mortality](https://substack.com/redirect/6ffbd327-d330-47a3-b3f2-81fa6368e5df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as well. Facts just aren't the Republican's thing--controlling women and children, is.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LHTVt45Y6A0a-_XpGCak6lj0sjwFX2_E87HPhI0BGfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144640319)
West Virginia and Wyoming Republicans have also launched efforts to protect child marriage. And in New Hampshire, as recently as 2018, child marriage was legal for girls as young [as 13 and boys as young as 14](https://substack.com/redirect/92918669-54df-4c3b-af4a-4a628c34c472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is particularly concerning because about 86% of child marriages are of young girls to male adults. Worse, efforts to ban child marriage in New Hampshire faced opposition from legislators when 174 Republicans voted _against_ a bill to ban child marriage. One Republican lawmaker, State Representative Jess Edwards, described teen girls as "ripe and fertile,"--horrifying remarks that I address below:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2953c0b4-b5a7-42b2-9f11-023052a8a660?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Missouri tells a similar story, where Republicans continue to block attempts to raise the marriage age by arguing for "parental rights and traditional values," regardless of the immense harm to children. As reported by the [Missouri Independent](https://substack.com/redirect/cc0e4725-30d9-4d59-8245-072227f29278?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The current law allows children aged 16 and 17 to marry with parental consent and younger children to marry with a judge's approval. Until the legislature voted to raise the minimum marriage age to 16 in 2018, Missouri had among the most [lenient](https://substack.com/redirect/cf92d3fa-a8ab-41fa-a999-84cc9237c0b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) child marriage laws in the nation -- making it an especially popular state for [15-year-olds](https://substack.com/redirect/de7e505e-9108-4246-ae30-ec7d9c3e25c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to travel to be married. Despite the 2018 change, Missouri law still does not align with international human rights standards, which set the minimum age at 18. [A]round 70 minors every year are entered into marriage in Missouri.
And the fact is, this hypocrisy extends beyond child marriage. The Republican Party, which often claims to champion the protection of children, also supports policies that endanger and undermine the well-being of minors. They are proponents of child labor laws, opponents of free school lunches for children, adversaries of the child tax credit, and critics of Medicaid expansion, which disproportionately benefits low-income children. I made this point in a [viral tweet last year](https://substack.com/redirect/969f2a06-49b6-428f-ba96-bcb2aae06f04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), its virality indicating that many people see this hypocrisy for the cruel reality that it is.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8f09a79d-142a-4d52-9b33-0dbad38977e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But surely there are international laws that ban child marriage, right? Well, it's sort of a good news/bad news situation. The good news is yes, there are international laws and treaties that ban child marriage. For example, the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW) calls for action to [specify a minimum marriage age of 18](https://substack.com/redirect/1b863761-277e-4fa7-9b31-cb8826fbea5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Therefore, any U.S. state law which forces minors into marriage is a de facto violation of CEDAW. The tragic bad news is that while 186 of 193 countries have ratified the CEDAW treaty, the United States shamefully remains as one of only seven countries that has to date refused to ratify it. We join Iran, Sudan, Somalia, Nauru, Palau, and Tonga on this indefensible list. Therefore, CEDAW does not apply in the United States. Meanwhile, no Federal legislation exists to ban child marriage in the United States either.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LHTVt45Y6A0a-_XpGCak6lj0sjwFX2_E87HPhI0BGfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144640319)
**Finally, let 's talk solutions. **Because, all of the above notwithstanding, Democrats aren't off the hook either, and must do better. [As documented by UNICEF](https://substack.com/redirect/3ee23ac9-507a-4a47-a807-996004e59be5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), only Connecticut, Delaware, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Washington have banned child marriage under the age of 18. That leaves 39 states where child marriage is still legal and recognized. It's long past time for change. Children forced into child marriages are often helpless, but we as adults, are not. So what can you do?
The leading organization to help pass bans on child marriage is Unchained At Last. Visit their [website](https://substack.com/redirect/54969633-467a-43b0-9579-ec4495c4cd2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), sign up for their newsletter, and if you can, contribute to their cause. Likewise, call upon your lawmakers to end this harmful practice and align with modern standards of human rights and dignity. We can do so by pressuring state lawmakers to ban child marriage on the state level, pressure federal lawmakers to pass national legislation banning child marriage (and let the Supremacy Clause quash all child marriage laws), and pressure the White House and Congress to ratify CEDAW and bring the United States up to speed with the vast majority of humanity.
Experts estimate that in 2024, roughly 50 minors will be forced into a child marriage _every week_ in the United States. That number must come down to zero. It is critical we continue to speak up, create more awareness, and bring about this life saving change for human rights in the United States.

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”. The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors. I am writing today to extend my deepest thanks for your support and your commitment to defending our democracy against people like Kari Lake and Donald Trump.
#

I am writing today to extend my deepest thanks for your support and your commitment to defending our democracy against people like Kari Lake and Donald Trump.
Your well-wishes and unity have sustained me and are **an essential part of our success in this campaign, and in the fight for democracy across the country.**
**We have already out-raised Kari Lake and are doing well in the polls, but this campaign just changed in a major way.**
Kari Lake just rolled out $10 MILLION in television advertisements, running in Arizona, all the way to Election Day. This is a HUGE buy. We’re scrambling to respond.
**Tonight is our mid-month fundraising deadline and the mid-point to the official FEC deadline,** and it would mean a lot to me if you could help us fight back against this major buy from Kari Lake by making a generous contribution to our campaign for victory in Arizona in 2024. [**Will you send in $5, $10, $25 or more today?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240515-1-160&t=1&akid=2328%2E734936%2Ek8tETw)
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240515-1-160&t=2&akid=2328%2E734936%2Ek8tETw)
With your help, we are looking to **organize and mobilize supporters all across Arizona,** both **in our race** and also to ensure we **defeat Donald Trump** and **pass a Constitutional amendment protecting abortion access in Arizona.** That is what we have to do to hold the Senate and the White House.
This is a critical moment for democracy in the country, and every single last bit of support makes a difference before our mid-month fundraising deadline ends.
I am grateful for anything you can give, and I hope you stay engaged in our fight through the months to come.
**[**Please make a well-timed, generous donation to my campaign today.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may24.hD4hyN&refcode=em240515-1-160&t=3&akid=2328%2E734936%2Ek8tETw)

Ruben Gallego

Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.
**The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland.** That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.

[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friends, it’s official: I just won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.
The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland. That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.
My team has a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation right now between my campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand to become a General Election Founding Donor? RUSH A DONATION [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_alsobrooks?amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode=jtk5035-bu-d]
As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.
But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.
As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.
On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.
The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.
I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources ASAP to start putting his feet to the fire.
We just have 7 months to win this race, so we need your help ASAP. body:
Updates & events from the campaign trail.

** PRIORITIES (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=28cf098e68&e=fc26432468) | VOLUNTEER (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=dd240b3816&e=fc26432468) | MEDIA | (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=af5e3dc259&e=fc26432468) CONTRIBUTE (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=94f81f208c&e=fc26432468)
------------------------------------------------------------

Peter -

My name is Linnea Saltz. I am Drew's campaign manager. I'm also the first woman ever to sue the NCAA because I was forced to compete against a biological male.

Last month, the Biden administration did what I always considered unthinkable, rewriting Title IX to redefine sex discrimination to include “gender identity." What this means is that what happened to me in 2020 will continue to happen to women all across the country.

Back in 2020, when I was competing on Southern Utah University's track and field team, I was forced to compete against the first ever male-to-female transgender athlete in NCAA Division I. An individual who was born a male and competed as a male for 3 years at the University of Montana was identifying as a female and set to compete against me and my teammates.

As the defending Big Sky Conference Champion in the 800m, with a personal best time of 2 minutes and 5 seconds, it was unbelievable to me that the NCAA would allow a male athlete who ran this race in 1 minute and 55 seconds (a world record time for women) to toe the line with the rest of the female athletes working tirelessly to win a prestigious conference title.

This started my advocacy for keeping women's sports women-only. From speaking on the main stage at CPAC (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=72767bf6f5&e=fc26432468) to being featured on national news outlets such as (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=e40efdeaa1&e=fc26432468) Fox (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=cc98b016e5&e=fc26432468) News (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=eaefe47f9a&e=fc26432468) , I've fought to protect women's sports and keep men out of women's bathrooms, locker rooms, and dorms. And now I am fighting alongside Drew. When Drew first heard my story, he was motivated to become an advocate for people like me and an ally for women's rights when he is elected this November. That is why friends and advocacy partners, including Riley Gaines, have come out in support of electing Drew to Congress.

I am proud to work for someone like Drew, who will advance women's rights, continue to fight for women, and ensure that women's spaces are for women only.
https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=38bf74a1f6&e=fc26432468
https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=aefc6a132b&e=fc26432468

PS - If you know someone who would be interested in learning more about our campaign to turn this crucial toss-up House seat Republican, please forward them this email (https://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ba92ef718a&e=fc26432468) .

Endorsement Alert!

Drew recently received an endorsement from beloved Boulder City Mayor Joe Hardy. Dr. Hardy represented much of what's now Nevada's 3rd congressional district in the NV Assembly and NV Senate before serving as mayor of Boulder City. We are thrilled to have his support!

NevadansCAN endorsed Drew for U.S. Congress! NevadansCAN is an amazingly effective grassroots network of hardworking citizen activists committed to defending the Constitution and promoting American values.

** On the Campaign Trail
------------------------------------------------------------

A huge thank you to Dr. Cameron and Deborah Earl for hosting a fantastic event in Summerlin for our campaign. It was an amazing success and our team is beyond grateful for the support of so many wonderful people across this district.
Drew was able to catch up with LVMPD Enterprise Area Command (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=0c9d928290&e=fc26432468) officers at their "Coffee with a Cop" event. They talked about what's working and what's not in the effort to address homelessness, and Drew met amazing leaders in the local foster care and health care communities. Drew says the best part of running for office is getting to know inspiring people who dedicate their careers to helping others and making life better here in Southern Nevada!
Drew and Sarah have participated in the AIDS Walk Las Vegas (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=d85f053257&e=fc26432468) and supported AFAN since 2016. Their family has been impacted by HIV, so Drew is particularly appreciative of AFAN's amazing work to provide assistance to Nevadans living with HIV/AIDS! Congrats to AFAN on another incredible walk!

Drew and Sarah were proud to support the inspiring team at the Women’s Resource Medical Centers (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=6b21305faa&e=fc26432468) of Southern Nevada and excited to share a moment with conservative champion Elisabeth Hasselbeck.
A big thank you to all the patriots who stopped by our table at the Western Trails Gun and Knife (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=eb2234de90&e=fc26432468) Show! Drew enjoyed catching up with friends from VFW Post 10047 and spending time with attorney and gun rights champion Don Green!
Drew appreciated the warm welcome he received in Laughlin last week! About 50 supporters crowded in Gilligan's Tavern to meet with Drew. Laughlin residents are facing some very unique challenges with water and remaining competitive with their neighbors across the river in Arizona. Susie Lee has ignored this great community, but Drew will fight to give them a voice!

** Upcoming Events
------------------------------------------------------------

** May 14 | 5:30 PM - 7 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Join us in Queensridge for a
Meet-and-Greet with Drew hosted by our wonderful supporter Minnie. Email Linnea (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Meet%20and%20Greet%20on%20May%2014%20(Queensridge)) to RSVP. Address will be given upon RSVP.

** May 15 | 6 - 8 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
The Cobblestone Cottage is hosting a
Meet-and-Greet Fundraiser for Drew. You're invited to an evening of great company, delicious food, and a chance to discuss the issues that matter most to you at one of the most charming venues in Las Vegas! This unique fundraiser is aimed at celebrating Republican activists and conservative volunteers who have been so helpful to Drew's campaign for Congress! Email Linnea to RSVP. (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Cobblestone%20Cottage%20RSVP)

** May 17 | 6 - 8 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Join us on May 17 for a fundraiser in
The Summit Club. There will be amazing special guests and a silent auction. Email Linnea to RSVP. (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Summit%20Club%20RSVP) Address will be given upon RSVP.

** May 22 | 6 - 8 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Our friend Rose will be hosting a
Meet-and-Greet for Drew at her home in Enterprise / Mountain's Edge (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ab795fe2b0&e=fc26432468) . Email Linnea (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Enterprise%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20RSVP) to RSVP.

** May 26 | 5:30 - 7 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
Josie Harrison with be hosting a
Meet-and-Greet on Sunday, May 26th. Email Linnea to RSVP. (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Summit%20Club%20RSVP)

** May 28 | 5 - 7 PM
------------------------------------------------------------
You won't want to miss this! We're having a Meet-and-Greet on May 28 at the
world-famous Pioneer Saloon! Make the short drive to Goodsprings to grab a cool beverage and a great burger, and let's talk politics at one of America's best bars! Email Linnea to RSVP. (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Summit%20Club%20RSVP)

** Get a Yard Sign for your Home!
------------------------------------------------------------
Show your support for Drew by putting a yard sign in the front of your home!

One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign within 30 days of the June 11 primary election. That means you can put them up NOW!

Get your FREE sign and we'll deliver it right to your door!

Email your name and address to info@DrewforNevada (mailto:info@DrewforNevada?subject=YARD%20SIGN!) and we'll ship one at NO COST to you!

You can help our campaign with this small, but vitally important show of support!

** YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!
------------------------------------------------------------

Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the TOP 3 ways YOU can get involved:

1. Donate: Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a huge difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! You can contribute to the campaign HERE (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=5c6d237b91&e=fc26432468) .

2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email linnea@drewfornevada.com (mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!) .

3. Volunteer for the Campaign: #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit THIS (https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=4430c1a789&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

## New Business: Welcome to Mesoscale.
You're going to see a new name on this page and in your emails with your weekly disaster briefs, features, and podcast episodes.
"Whistleblower News" is becoming "**Mesoscale.News** " starting this week to better capture the goals and objectives of this work.
In meteorology, "mesoscale" reflects the area of the atmosphere from about 5 to 250 km from the surface-- the most volatile and unpredictable part of our weather surface.
Like this newsletter, we step back from the issues to see the larger picture, but remain close enough to the ground to cover the details that matter most (without getting drug down into the swamp).
The weekly disaster briefs illustrate this concept, and have quickly the most popular aspect of my Substack work.
A paid subscription here ($50/year or $5/month) gets you access to all new and archived posts, all podcast episodes, breaking and investigative pieces, and serves as the "Master Key" to unlock access to all my outside projects.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..dVMF1zrGLiL0NyWTrrjkq0FWigPlM76JBNqIKVfcghQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144656895)
Florida residents using a Florida billing address[ can click here to save 20% on the annual cost](https://substack.com/redirect/a1bac48f-949b-4bd1-bbe4-68fe55656591?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* * *
## Midweek Briefs:
**Geological:**
A stratovolcano on Indonesia's Halmahera Island[ began erupting yesterday,](https://substack.com/redirect/367268fb-4d36-4603-aaf8-2eb0cd8b7d05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) May 14, 2024. That brings the total number of actively erupting volcanoes in the world up to 30.
**Hurricanes:**
The Pacific Ocean tropical cyclone season starts today; the Atlantic Ocean season starts June 1.
There are currently two tropical disturbances:
One in the [west Indian Ocean,](https://substack.com/redirect/c64a7163-916e-45ac-8f69-5c7d2c9e4395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and one in the [western Pacific Ocean](https://substack.com/redirect/68d91cd0-86bd-4423-bec8-e3b861d69a10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Neither appear to be developing into stronger systems, but areas already struggling with intense rainfall and flooding (including Kenya) could suffer disproportionately if the storms bring heavy rains even without strong winds.
* * *
## Feature: Fact Checking Claims About UN's Gaza Death Toll
Social media was ablaze earlier this week about an alleged halving of the United Nation's total death toll of women and children killed in Gaza.
"UN cuts women, child deaths in Gaza by half overnight," went the story.
Like a lot of stories about the situation overseas, this one was completely false.
The UN has been publishing data about fatalities in Gaza since the start of the assault, using comparative analysis across varying (and often adversarial) resources.
These numbers are backed up by both Israeli and American intelligence, as well as the international agencies deployed to the region ([like the 20 American doctors trapped in Gaza who are slowly dying due to Israel's blockade of aid](https://substack.com/redirect/45b6e8f1-6165-4d57-9720-a1db96858970?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
Last week, the UN updated how it categorizes this data online, separating the number of dead who have been identified from the dead who have not (and may never be because of their condition).
Israeli propagandists, including Oren Marmorstein (spokesperson for Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs) seized the opportunity to[ exploit confusion ](https://substack.com/redirect/54ff7fa6-1aeb-4d71-b610-96f7652c010c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of the change and began circulating lies that the actual death toll of children was half of what was being said the entire time.
[Fox News ran with it (of course)](https://substack.com/redirect/b5b9e30f-4955-4e93-b41b-cba6cee843d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
By the time the UN[ began explaining the change](https://substack.com/redirect/0edd8bb3-24f7-4125-8255-8202d329675e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- simply distinguishing those who have been identified vs bodies with no identity yet -- the lie had already consumed the social media airwaves.
Two people I believe to be incredibly smart even fell for it -- sharing it widely, adding commentary on how they believed the numbers to be lies "all along."
I've been counting the dead in disasters a very long time. Fatalities in war can be examined in much of the same way as fatalities from a hurricane.
If the counts are done properly, they will almost always go up over time, although [there have been exceptions](https://substack.com/@sethabramson/note/c-44220968).
That there are more than 7,000 bodies of just children that have gone unidentified is in itself a terrifying reality of how brutal Israel's attacks on Gaza have been.
Typically, if a body hasn't been identified, it's because either the body was damaged beyond recognition or no one is still alive who would be able to identify the corpse.
In this conflict, there may be the additional complication of no facilities left to even process bodies, as Israel has bombed most of the hospitals and other critical infrastructure that serve the more than 2 million people living there.
The [UN's explanation ](https://substack.com/redirect/b42e8b5d-115a-42a0-a1b1-77af0ecffa9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)seems to focus on the first two points: more than 7,000 children have either been so disfigured, dismembered or left in small pieces that even family cannot identify them, or there is no family left to do so.
Neither are things those supporting the Israeli cause should be proud of.
Additionally, more than 10,000 people are believed to be dead beneath the rubble of what Israel has destroyed.
And then there are the horror stories of those who were never reported missing being found in acts of such depravity that hope of finding everyone seems slim.
So far, [more than 500 people](https://substack.com/redirect/02363fed-63a6-4bf6-9e62-31dc5b209666?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- mostly medical staff-- have been found in mass graves at three different hospitals in Gaza. The bodies found in a total of seven mass graves showed signs of mutilation and torture, and were buried with their hands and feet tied together -- shot execution style by the IDF and thrown in a hole.
Identifications made thus far have been dependent on ID badges and relatives identifying clothing.
Those conditions make it doubtful that all of the Israel's victims will ever be identifiable -- or even found.

Fellow American - my name is Curtis Bashaw, and I am running for Senate in a major sleeper race, where we have the opportunity to make history and flip this seat for the first time since 1972.

**_In a moment I am going to ask you for a critical donation ahead of our mid-month fundraising deadline, but let me explain first why your support is so crucial._**

In high school, I started working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. Since then, I’ve been working nonstop. I started a business 35 years ago and am a proud job creator, employing more than 1,000 hard-working people today.

As an entrepreneur, I have the responsibility of making a payroll every two weeks, and I know that people’s car payments, rent, and mortgages depend on me and our team effectively doing our job. It’s never been easy, _but it’s always been worth it._

**As a business owner and a product of the American dream, I’m a lifelong Republican. Nancy Dahlstrom Endorsed by Elise Stefanik's E-PAC

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom was endorsed by
House Republican Conference chairwoman Elise Stefanik's Elevate PAC in
her campaign for Alaska's At-Large congressional seat. E-PAC aims to
elect Republican women to Congress and elevate women's voices in the
national legislature.

Dahlstrom also has the backing of Governor Mike Dunleavy and Republican
Leadership including Speaker Mike Johnson, Leader Steve Scalise, and
Whip Tom Emmer, and Chairwoman Elise Stefanik.

"I am honored to receive E-PAC's endorsement to become Alaska's next
representative in the U.S. House of Representatives. E-PAC understands
the need to elevate conservative women's voices in a time where our
voices are being overshadowed by leftist Democrats' out-of-touch policy
pushes," said Lt. Gov. Dahlstrom. "I look forward to bringing true
conservative leadership to Congress and ending Mary Peltola's
disappointing tenure in Congress. Alaska desperately needs someone who
will embody our state's values in our esteemed Capitol."

subject: Speak up! Tell utilities we don't need more gas
body:
Energy demand is growing, but the answer isn't more gas
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2551016/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi— |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2551017/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
[SPEAK UP NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2551018/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Those of us in climate have long known that electrifying our economy will mean we need more electricity, and the obvious solution is for utilities to invest in affordable, reliable clean energy—it's more resilient, it's cheaper than gas, and money from the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) makes it even cheaper.

But despite this obvious solution, Big Oil and Gas are using the higher demand to justify building out more dirty gas power plants, even going as far as to falsely overstate the demand.

**Some utilities are even ignoring clean energy's cheaper price tag so that they can charge consumers for the costs of building these unnecessary new gas power plants.**

This is just plain dumb—and more than that, it's dangerous. Climate pollution and air pollution from "natural" gas are a danger to our health, our communities, and our future.

**Speak up now:**[**Tell utility regulators they don't need new gas to address growing demand.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2551019/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[NO NEW GAS!](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2551020/87SdQ4wZ)

| Sincerely, |

| Peter,

Today is Mother's Day in the United States, a day that can evoke a wide range of emotions. Whether you are celebrating or struggling today, know that our hearts are with you.

The Center for Reproductive Rights is fighting to ensure that every person can decide if and when to become a mother—and that no matter where you live, you have access to the essential reproductive health care you need.

That means access to abortion care, prenatal care and postpartum care, and lifelong reproductive health care. _**But as you know, access isn't guaranteed.**_

... Pregnant people in Texas, Tennessee, Idaho, Oklahoma and beyond are fighting for the right to access essential and life-saving abortion care. People like Amanda Zurawski, the lead plaintiff in our case against the state of Texas’s inhumane abortion bans, who spent three days fighting for her life in a Texas ICU after being denied reproductive health care.

... In Hawai'i, we are challenging a law that prevents pregnant people from receiving prenatal and birth care from trusted, skilled midwives. Our lawsuit seeks to expand access to maternal health care and end this restrictive law that particularly harms Native Hawaiian midwifery practitioners and families of color.

... In partnership with Lift Louisiana, Physicians for Human Rights, and Reproductive Health Impact, the Center released a report documenting the devastating harms caused by Louisiana’s extreme abortion bans. The study details how Louisiana’s laws have changed the day-to-day practice of medicine and the devastating impact they have on people seeking reproductive health care, their communities, and the people who care for them.

The Center stands firm that when it comes to health and access inequities—more reproductive autonomy is the solution, not less. Your commitment to the Center fuels our mission to ensure everyone, everywhere, is able to make decisions about their health, bodies, and futures.

[**We urge you to join us in this fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84986050/473295297/2039007406?sourceid=1149591&utm_campaign=24emfr052411aax&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=fye&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyN2E4ZTEwOC1jZTEyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cN5fbvxNvSJ8LhdIv-4-bY0YHTtcgQrgaw8GkaIYKuY=&emci=2fe594e0-5a11-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=27a8e108-ce12-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)

In solidarity, Gabriella Morris Chief Development Officer From: Nancy Northup <info@reprorights.org> Sent: Sunday, May 12, 2024 10:04 AM To: <dpwillis67@gmail.com> Subject: On Mother’s Day... | | ---|--- | Peter, Today is Mother's Day in the United States, a day that can evoke a wide range of emotions. Whether you are celebrating or struggling today, know that our hearts are with you. The Center for Reproductive Rights is fighting to ensure that every person can decide if and when to become a mother—and that no matter where you live, you have access to the essential reproductive health care you need. That means access to abortion care, prenatal care and postpartum care, and lifelong reproductive health care. But as you know, access isn't guaranteed.** ... Pregnant people in Texas, Tennessee, Idaho, Oklahoma and beyond are fighting for the right to access essential and life-saving abortion care. People like Amanda Zurawski, the lead plaintiff in our case against the state of Texas’s inhumane abortion bans, who spent three days fighting for her life in a Texas ICU after being denied reproductive health care. ... In Hawai'i, we are challenging a law that prevents pregnant people from receiving prenatal and birth care from trusted, skilled midwives. Our lawsuit seeks to expand access to maternal health care and end this restrictive law that particularly harms Native Hawaiian midwifery practitioners and families of color. ... In partnership with Lift Louisiana, Physicians for Human Rights, and Reproductive Health Impact, the Center released a report documenting the devastating harms caused by Louisiana’s extreme abortion bans. The study details how Louisiana’s laws have changed the day-to-day practice of medicine and the devastating impact they have on people seeking reproductive health care, their communities, and the people who care for them. The Center stands firm that when it comes to health and access inequities—more reproductive autonomy is the solution, not less. Your commitment to the Center fuels our mission to ensure everyone, everywhere, is able to make decisions about their health, bodies, and futures. In solidarity and health, Nancy Northup President & CEO | "DONATE NOW" | | | | ---|---|--- The Center for Reproductive Rights uses the power of law to advance reproductive rights as fundamental human rights around the world. © Center for Reproductive Rights Center for Reproductive Rights 199 Water St. New York, NY 10038 United States

[ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43398?t=7&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i) Guess what, I was right.

I’ve been screaming from the rooftops that my friend Josh Riley’s race here in NY-19 is the top race Democrats need to win to take back the House... and finally, folks are catching on.

In case you missed the news, Josh just earned a spot on the national Democrats’ highly exclusive ‘Red-to-Blue’ list. Only a handful of races in the entire country made the cut, and it goes to show how competitive and important this race will be.

**I hate to say ‘I told you so,’ but I kind of did.** I know Josh has what it takes to win, and I’m thrilled they see it too. [**This is a key moment in his race, and Josh needs our help to keep up the momentum. So today, I’m asking you to split $5, $25, or whatever you can between Josh and Fight for Reform to help Josh win in NY-19 and elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43398?t=8&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Josh Riley will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43399?t=9&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43402?t=12&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43398?t=13&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i)
Let’s be real: there’s no taking back the House majority without flipping districts like NY-19. I know, and national Democrats know, that Josh is just the guy to do the job.

Josh was my counsel in the Senate, and he’s the hardest working person I know. Together, we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. (We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad.) **Josh ran in this district in 2022, and came up short by 1.6% – and he’s going to win this time with our help.**
[**So if you’re all-in to take back the House this November, I need you to get serious about Josh’s race. Please donate anything you can (seriously, every dollar helps) to Fight for Reform and Josh today to send Marc Molinaro packing and get the Speaker’s gavel out of Mike Johnson’s hands.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43398?t=14&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i)
Thanks,

Al

P.S. I look pretty smart now that everyone else is realizing just how important Josh’s race is, huh? [**You can look like a political genius too – donate today!**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/43398?t=15&akid=21401%2E4449941%2EZzAv6i)

Fellow American,

[](https://click.conservativeinamerica.com/u/click?_t=f7e0cf91482847a4a92b501b335089ff&_m=632701941ac24bbfad3f97d57ac2dbf1&_e=FLU_89QzK0FrGHByBYir1wXuBJclG9htx8ebGdteiPDS78EwPsC1zWX3SomLvFXYDhNePXlsxQcVYmb7uZRnt0_L2dMagPmsmLIkwobtS9RiRyQpuKOtNixROev2I57wlBGDotdHeCfN4UtIwc9DFkB2peEo3Ffv1ijRvCNdaIS-8RzSl0aKfHLq62QcYVrjKf8zjtWF_2qB1G7lh_KqkAf4VO3foYGcehA6lYS5p7P2FYoz4vVpKkc8fndGB23qzTJJqUjz9I-zS22QRrax40e2XQleUvEBpT3J9DoKZwrskuDd5lKz-Z0pwN3jdggqzUK3CCSJmzy1XMsr7siO70UxjmKQ1-7-THFt9_WJT7lbGdlsDbKjDQ3-OXV_5vHWVf7CTqQirSnGizKtUMCfnlS7W79ZwR9MgoYh5iwHsEQ%3D) Yes. I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism.

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio.

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

**[Please, will you stand with me and make a special donation of $25, $50, or $100 to stand with me?](https://click.conservativeinamerica.com/u/click?_t=f7e0cf91482847a4a92b501b335089ff&_m=632701941ac24bbfad3f97d57ac2dbf1&_e=FLU_89QzK0FrGHByBYir1wXuBJclG9htx8ebGdteiPDS78EwPsC1zWX3SomLvFXYDhNePXlsxQcVYmb7uZRnt0_L2dMagPmsmLIkwobtS9RiRyQpuKOtNixROev2I57wlBGDotdHeCfN4UtIwc9DFkB2peEo3Ffv1ijRvCNdaIS-8RzSl0aKfHLq62QcYVrjKf8zjtWF_2qB1G7lh_KqkAf4VO3foYGcehA6lYS5p7P2FYoz4vVpKkc8fndGB23qzTJJqUjz9I-zS22QRrax41BNSO8XBHezmpWHqAAeUdcJzUbXOU08hKKqpKFxww649wc0Oc0gYQs4y78ZYdTmRrnKz_6Gtfa80LS3Y9_QTMuI_5m18pi55uDaTn-LbN16ha70mb9S9zHEIwQouGyT5RE2ZgLZM30I7wBVHqwgY3Q%3D)**

_Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil._

**[That's why I need you to stand with me and preserve the freedoms and values of our American heritage.](https://click.conservativeinamerica.com/u/click?_t=f7e0cf91482847a4a92b501b335089ff&_m=632701941ac24bbfad3f97d57ac2dbf1&_e=FLU_89QzK0FrGHByBYir1wXuBJclG9htx8ebGdteiPDS78EwPsC1zWX3SomLvFXYDhNePXlsxQcVYmb7uZRnt0_L2dMagPmsmLIkwobtS9RiRyQpuKOtNixROev2I57wlBGDotdHeCfN4UtIwc9DFkB2peEo3Ffv1ijRvCNdaIS-8RzSl0aKfHLq62QcYVrjKf8zjtWF_2qB1G7lh_KqkAf4VO3foYGcehA6lYS5p7P2FYoz4vVpKkc8fndGB23qzTJJqUjz9I-zS22QRrax4__k-5SVEFh2CR7wTJkquljmCYxVJb6ZuIH3z0up41W1ZDbfNW7X_cj4eCbwASlD8jhTCTvl_qHlXsyPURweyI6yizVHX9MXyoMoR7qrJM8XXnVwlkpMqTqhPXIvO0sOY2F-iLSYNG8dMM6fklvNNLA%3D)**

For freedom,

name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zehcbajs75nfnf24m7f32k6lrjsr6gna04a1ie60_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g68ob4c5h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhs76e5fm8ubps9qj8up0tpqvid1euaprtuienng_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g68ob4c5h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---
P.S. I know how we got to this point in our country, and I know how we get out. But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z30bbtmrauth3rj4jnf6mbjrkd23garm7afho88g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g68ob4c5h2bs)**

I was honored to speak at the Schoharie County Democrats' FDR Dinner in Cobleskill. Congratulations to Democratic Committee Chair Theresa Heary. It was a gorgeous event, with about 95 Democrats in attendance. Who said there are no Democrats in rural upstate New York, right?
A reminder to all Democrats: we need to, frequently and shamelessly, practice our First Amendment Rights to peaceably assemble.
Shout out to fellow candidates who attended last night's event in Cobleskill: NY State Senate candidate Michelle Frazier and State Assembly candidates Mary Finnerman and Janet Tweed. And Tom DiNapoli: I think you have an official, ever-increasing fan club. Who would have thought that we could love our state's Comptroller so much?
The occasion of the FDR Dinner was a reason to reflect on the legacy of our 32nd President. Without a doubt, FDR was one of the greatest Democratic leaders we have ever had. In the 20th Century, he defended our free world against authoritarianism and autocracy abroad. Now, less than 100 years later, the MAGA Republicans under the leadership of Donald Trump have a 920-page written document known as Project 2025, which is a domestic strategy to impose authoritarianism and autocracy from within.
I'm mad as hell about it. You should be, too.
I'm mad that they want to impose mass deportations of our immigrants and asylum seekers.
I'm mad that they want to dismantle our government and administrative agencies, such as the EPA, Department of Education, and the FDA.
And the big one, for which I'm almost beyond words - I'm mad as HELL that they want to deprive all women of the right to choose. They want to end gender-affirming care. They call out military women in particular - no abortions for our women in uniform.
I'm mad as hell about the total abortion ban they are systematically imposing in the states and that they intend to impose at the federal level. And you should be, too.
I struggle to understand how any woman, or anyone who knows a woman, can be supportive of an abortion ban. In my own family, if my daughter were to conceive, her life would be in danger almost immediately. Are the MAGAs saying that they would rather see my daughter die than allow access to medical interventions? How can any woman, or any mother, or any human with an ounce of compassion, support such an idea?
Unthinkable.
How did we get here?
Well, I think we've been fleeced. We elected people like my Republican opponent, Elise Stefanik, who in 2014 called herself a moderate, and since then has been on an unbridled power grab. That's right - We've been fleeced by Elise.
Two years ago, Elise Stefanik promised generous support to Ukraine, and just a few weeks ago, she voted no to vital funding in the war against Putin. Again, we've been fleeced by Elise.
She calls herself pro-military and pro-police, and yet after January 6th, Elise supported Election Deniers and Insurrectionists who beat and killed police brutally in our nation's capitol. On this issue, in a big way, we've been fleeced by Elise. And reminder: if you're a woman in the military, Elise wants to take away your right to an abortion. Maybe she should say she is pro-male-military.
Numerous projects of the American Rescue Plan Act are now in full swing. Drive around NY21, get caught in traffic for a construction project, and thank your lucky stars that the Democrats passed a $1.9 trillion stimulus package to create jobs, restore our economy, and protect our infrastructure. Stefanik voted against this vital funding, and yet every time there is a ribbon-cutting, there's Elise, smiling, posing for photos, taking credit. Repeat chorus: we've been fleeced by Elise.
We cannot let them win. The MAGA Mania stops here. I'm calling on every person reading this to embrace your vital role as Democrats. Talk to your neighbors. Talk to your co-workers. Get that slight pink-cheeked-feeling-of-embarrassment when you bring up a squirmy subject and remind your older relatives that Trump and Stefanik and all the MAGAs are coming for their Social Security. They couldn't care less whether your adorable niece lives or dies if she happens to get pregnant. Their stated goal is to dismantle our government. And they will delight in the ensuing chaos. They have a systematic, 920-page written plan to impose the very thing that FDR was fighting against abroad -- authoritarianism and autocracy. I'm mad as hell about it, and you should be, too.
We must not let them advance.
The MAGA Mania stops here.
I'm Paula Collins, Democratic candidate for Congress, and I am asking for your vote in November.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Fake Newspaper Company Publishes IL Voter Data that Revealed Names and Home Addresses of Human Trafficking Domestic Violence Victims (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Publications founded by Dan Proft under LGIS and now run by Brian Timpone.

By Illinois Review

A Lake County Judge has ordered (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/05/10/judge-orders-pink-slime-publications-to-remove-voters-personal-information/?lctg=443D14D13572C4AB7490B4ED9B&utm_email=443D14D13572C4AB7490B4ED9B&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_term=https%3a%2f%2fwww.chicagotribune.com%2f2024%2f05%2f10%2fjudge-orders-pink-slime-publications-to-remove-voters-personal-information%2f&utm_campaign=CT-Breaking-News&utm_content=alert&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Illinois-based publishing company Local Government Information Services (LGIS) to remove sensitive voter data from their websites that was illegally published and includes the names and home addresses of police officers, domestic violence and human trafficking victims.

LGIS publishes content for a select group of conservative political candidates – information oftentimes submitted by the candidate and not a reporter and published in newspapers to make it appear as if the information is coming from a reliable and legitimate news source. Publications such as the “Chicago City Wire,” the “Will County Gazette” and the “DuPage Policy Journal” are all owned and operated by LGIS.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In 2016, Dan Proft – now a Florida-based Chicago radio show host, launched LGIS – an Illinois-based for-profit publication company at the same time he was running the Liberty Principles PAC – and as records reveal, would use the money from his own PAC to pay his own publication company to write favorable stories about candidates he was supporting. In 2019, Proft shut down (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2020/01/17/talk-show-host-dan-proft-shuts-down-2-pacs-including-one-that-was-once-a-multimillion-dollar-platform-to-push-conservatives/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) the PAC – which was funded by billionaire Richard Uihlein who had donated nearly $18 million. In 2016, the Illinois State Board of Elections found illegal coordination (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/04/29/at-secret-meeting-right-wing-radio-host-dangled-20-million-to-darren-baileys-governor-run/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) between the PAC and the political candidates that they were supporting.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

In 2020, Proft transitioned day-to-day operations of LGIS over to his best friend and business partner Brian Timpone, who now serves as LGIS’ president. In 2012, Timpone was forced to shut down his company Journatic LLC (https://www.cjr.org/behind_the_news/plagiarism_and_a_resignation_a.php?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) just three months into his partnership with the Chicago Tribune (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2012/07/22/journatic-ceo-brian-timpone-no-stranger-to-news-gathering-or-questions-about-ethics-2/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) after the Tribune’s partnership with Timpone became “an embarrassment after ethical breaches, including false bylines, plagiarism and fake quotations, were discovered.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

On Friday, a Lake County Judge ordered (https://www.chicagotribune.com/2024/05/10/judge-orders-pink-slime-publications-to-remove-voters-personal-information/?lctg=443D14D13572C4AB7490B4ED9B&utm_email=443D14D13572C4AB7490B4ED9B&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_term=https%3a%2f%2fwww.chicagotribune.com%2f2024%2f05%2f10%2fjudge-orders-pink-slime-publications-to-remove-voters-personal-information%2f&utm_campaign=CT-Breaking-News&utm_content=alert&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Timpone to remove personal information of voters that LGIS published illegally that disclosed the names and home addresses of hundreds of thousands of individuals including police officers, domestic abuse and human trafficking victims – making the point that the disclosures put the individuals in danger and open them up to identity theft.

The judge gave LGIS until 5 p.m. on Monday, May 13, 2024 to comply with the court order.

Check the full article (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/05/fake-newspaper-company-publishes-il-voter-data-that-revealed-names-and-home-addresses-of-human-trafficking-domestic-violence-victims.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=8127fff3ba-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for an important update about the status of LGIS' compliance with the court order.

CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () In 2016, Dan Proft – now a Florida-based Chicago radio show host, launched LGIS – an Illinois-based for-profit publication company at the same time he was running the Liberty Principles PAC – and as records reveal, would use the money from his own PAC to pay his own publication company to write favorable stories about candidates he was supporting. In 2019, Proft shut down () the PAC – which was funded by billionaire Richard Uihlein who had donated nearly $18 million. In 2016, the Illinois State Board of Elections found illegal coordination () between the PAC and the political candidates that they were supporting. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () In 2020, Proft transitioned day-to-day operations of LGIS over to his best friend and business partner Brian Timpone, who now serves as LGIS’ president. In 2012, Timpone was forced to shut down his company Journatic LLC () just three months into his partnership with the Chicago Tribune () after the Tribune’s partnership with Timpone became “an embarrassment after ethical breaches, including false bylines, plagiarism and fake quotations, were discovered.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () On Friday, a Lake County Judge ordered () Timpone to remove personal information of voters that LGIS published illegally that disclosed the names and home addresses of hundreds of thousands of individuals including police officers, domestic abuse and human trafficking victims – making the point that the disclosures put the individuals in danger and open them up to identity theft. The judge gave LGIS until 5 p.m. on Monday, May 13, 2024 to comply with the court order. Check the full article () for an important update about the status of LGIS' compliance with the court order.
