Hey there, it's Kellyanne.

_**[I was just catching up on the news when a few troubling headlines caught my eye. Would it be alright if I filled you in?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjrdcjve2bnmu4vpvnu32gd6cadm2n5l8adinen8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g64pj6c9h2bs "I was just catching up on the news when a few troubling headlines caught my eye. **- Fox News: **"Biden super PAC targets battleground states with largest ad purchase in US history"

**- NBC News: **"Biden fundraiser with Obama, Clinton rakes in $25 million"
Listen...

I don't like writing these emails. And I have a hunch you don't love reading them. I completely understand that. But the situation is dire. We are closing in on the biggest fundraising deadline this year and I don't see another option.

When I ran President Trump's first campaign, I didn't have the luxury of putting things off until tomorrow - not with Trump-hating Democrats, the Clinton Campaign, and Liberal Media breathing down our necks. **I had to be quick and decisive, so here 's my pitch to you: **

_**[Our Conservative House Majority is hanging on by a thread and the Democrats are WAY ahead of us in the fundraising race. Would you be willing to pitch in JUST ten or twenty bucks to defend our fragile House Majority before midnight?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfghgbi90aebvkkfcjfeklg1av6ii8g1loa2la5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g64pj6c9h2bs "Our Conservative House Majority is hanging on by a thread and the Democrats are WAY ahead of us in the fundraising race. Would you be willing to pitch in JUST ten or twenty bucks to defend our fragile House Majority before midnight?")**_

I know this to be true:

Our movement isn't quick to give up, even when the going gets tough. We are a Party of hard-working, patriotic, and commonsense Americans, including plumbers, teachers, doctors, farmers, ranchers, lawyers, and students - folks from every background and creed.

We won't just throw in the towel when Biden's favorite Super PAC unloads a quarter billion dollars against us... OR when our House Majority is razor-thin... OR when Democrats target our most vulnerable candidates in swing races...

_Even with the odds stacked against us, we always have a plan to overcome and WIN - just like when we shocked the world by defeating the "all-powerful" Hillary Rodham Clinton._

**That 's why I'm here to tell you that our plans for victory FULLY RELY on you.**

_**[I set out to convince EVERYONE reading this email to pitch in SOMETHING to the cause. Even five or ten bucks will go a long way when the stakes are this high.")**_

And believe me - they don't get any higher than this.

I couldn't thank you enough if you'd be willing to help. I mean that. So can I count on you to step up and pitch in any amount?

subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zph6d23iru77jt73up1dk36im8p8nub7vo3ukg5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g64pj6chh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: People are ready to take action to turn the tide in Texas.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

We just met with hundreds of volunteers during our largest organizing call
of the year, and one thing was clear: people are ready to take action to
turn the tide in Texas.

During the call I showed how our voter registration and relationship
program provides the kind of transformational action we need in a state as
important as ours. Participants on the call then signed up for trainings
and registration events in their communities. Encouraging to see so many
people step up!

Even if you weren’t able to join the call, it’s not too late to be part of
this program. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63486?t=1001&akid=239585%2E444211%2ExebiEx ]You can sign up here to get started.

But if you need more information before you make a decision, here’s a
quick recap of the call:

We reviewed the many voter registration tests we’ve run in 2024, like
meeting unregistered Democrats at their doors; texting unregistered
Democrats for whom we can find a cell phone; and finding unregistered
Democrats in public spaces. Thanks to our “test pilots” – volunteers who
got out there and tested each of these approaches – we now know what works
and what doesn’t work.

And what clearly works better than anything else is when Powered by People
volunteers show up to meet our future voters where they are. We’ve spent
hundreds of hours at dozens of locations across the state to get this
right. Our initial cohort of volunteers has been at work continuously
improving our approach to this, scouting the best spots to find
unregistered voters and the most effective ways to talk to, register and
stay in touch with them ahead of these upcoming elections.

From their work, we’ve developed a comprehensive program that includes
training, certification and – most importantly – action. And we want you
to be a part of it.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/63486?t=1002&akid=239585%2E444211%2ExebiEx ]If you are in Texas: sign up for a training and pick a registration
shift to get started right away.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/signup/texting-team/?source=em20240514&t=1003&akid=239585%2E444211%2ExebiEx ]If you are outside of Texas: sign up to join our texting team.

Questions? Join a training and one of our organizers will walk you through
what it takes to volunteer on the largest voter registration and
relationship program in Texas and answer any questions you have. I hope to
see you on our team and look forward to doing the work with you to help
Democrats win important races throughout the state.

Thank you,

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to act. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1004&akid=239585%2E444211%2ExebiEx

Participants on the call then signed up for trainings and registration events in their communities. Encouraging to see so many people step up! Even if you weren’t able to join the call, it’s not too late to be part of this program. [ ]You can sign up here to get started. But if you need more information before you make a decision, here’s a quick recap of the call: We reviewed the many voter registration tests we’ve run in 2024, like meeting unregistered Democrats at their doors; texting unregistered Democrats for whom we can find a cell phone; and finding unregistered Democrats in public spaces. Thanks to our “test pilots” – volunteers who got out there and tested each of these approaches – we now know what works and what doesn’t work. And what clearly works better than anything else is when Powered by People volunteers show up to meet our future voters where they are. We’ve spent hundreds of hours at dozens of locations across the state to get this right. Our initial cohort of volunteers has been at work continuously improving our approach to this, scouting the best spots to find unregistered voters and the most effective ways to talk to, register and stay in touch with them ahead of these upcoming elections. From their work, we’ve developed a comprehensive program that includes training, certification and – most importantly – action. And we want you to be a part of it. [ ]If you are in Texas: sign up for a training and pick a registration shift to get started right away. [ ]If you are outside of Texas: sign up to join our texting team. Questions? Join a training and one of our organizers will walk you through what it takes to volunteer on the largest voter registration and relationship program in Texas and answer any questions you have. I hope to see you on our team and look forward to doing the work with you to help Democrats win important races throughout the state. Thank you, Beto

And believe us, they will. But the honest truth is that your support today is about a lot more than putting up big numbers or keeping up appearances.

That's because the right wing and billionaires like Harlan Crow see me as one of their top-priority targets in Congress, and are getting ready to do and spend whatever it takes to defeat us.
They're going to drive up the cost of television spots in our district. They're going to try and drown out our digital outreach. And they're going to launch lie after lie and attack after attack to make it happen.
**We _need_ to build the kind of campaign that has what it takes to fight back and win. **
**Your support is how we do it.**

name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4q5ujq5ahhiefqhb18u3gqqkua8jf42kmue9e78_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g6coj4c5h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc8q5cbr64luquovrhd6d6fp9op33fp2eob6t7o8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35c3g6coj4c5h2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz

My opponent could undo all of that progress.

Can I count on you to support my campaign with a donation today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]

If Trump and his MAGA movement are successful in November, they’ll go after reproductive rights, civil rights, and our very democracy.

We aren’t going to defeat the MAGA movement with more yelling on Twitter. We’ll do it by putting people over politics and keeping leaders in Washington who are willing to make the hard choices to deliver for Americans.

That’s what I’m committed to doing, and I hope to count on your support

Seth

We all have a role to play in making sure this Senate seat stays blue.

Friends —
Last night, Democrat Angela Alsobrooks won her U.S. Senate primary in Maryland. Today, I am asking you to donate to her campaign. Let me explain why this request is so important:

| **American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) Endorses Congressman John Duarte **
---
| | **Modesto, CA** — Today, Congressman John Duarte announced that he has received an endorsement from the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC). AIPAC, a bipartisan organization representing millions of pro-Israel Americans, works to strengthen the alliance between the United States and Israel. With a mission to combat terrorism, promote economic development, and ensure the security of both nations, AIPAC’s endorsement highlights Congressman Duarte’s commitment to the U.S.-Israel partnership and its shared values.

In response to the endorsement, Congressman Duarte issued the following statement:

_“I am honored to receive an endorsement from AIPAC. The United States-Israel relationship is not just a strategic alliance; it’s a partnership in shared history, mutual respect, and common purpose. Today, as we confront challenges faced worldwide, it’s vital that we stand beside our allies. From securing our nation’s borders to combating terrorism and advancing shared economic prosperity, I will continue to be a strong ally with Israel.”_

Congressman Duarte’s endorsement by AIPAC comes at the heels of recent pro-Palestinian and antisemitic activities on college campuses nationwide. In the face of rising tensions and attempts to undermine the longstanding partnership between the United States and Israel, Congressman Duarte remains steadfast in his support for Israel’s right to defend itself and in the shared United States-Israel partnership. ###

I can win this election, but we can't do it without your help. _And here are three reasons why we must win:_
1. I believe that neither President Biden nor President Trump will navigate us through the looming debt crisis that threatens our country's very foundation.
2. Their strategies fall short in confronting the perpetual foreign conflicts. There’s no sign that either will halt the relentless cycle of these forever wars.
3. Nor do I see them severing the ties of vested interests that have led to the corporate capture of crucial agencies — whether it’s the Military Industrial Complex’s hold on the CIA, Big Pharma’s influence on the NIH, CDC, and FDA, or the USDA’s sway under Big Ag.

If either Biden or Trump are elected, change will only graze the surface; we’re likely to see minor shifts in policy areas like taxation or abortion rights, but not the sweeping reforms we so desperately need.
No, they won’t dismantle our democracy within their term—the resilience of American institutions is formidable—their presidencies are simply not set to veer away from the well-worn path of politics as usual.
But here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance, to rejuvenate the spirit of our democracy, and to rebuild our nation's standing on a global scale.
| | **"Here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance."**

This is about instilling a foreign policy not predicated on the show of military might but on the strength of our economy and the power of our values.
The possibility of enacting such pivotal change, of steering our country back to its principled course, is a calling too pivotal to ignore.
That's why the thought of backing down from this contest doesn’t cross my mind.
The prospect of what we can achieve together is immense, demanding unwavering commitment and a relentless pursuit of the vision we share for America.

Unfortunately, this right is often under attack, with attempts to undermine unions and weaken workers' ability to negotiate for fair wages and benefits. Let's elect candidates who will protect and defend workers' right to organize. = Thank you for your support, Hoosier Dems [content goes here] 101 W Washington St., #1110E Indianapolis, IN 46204 Paid for by the Indiana Democratic Party, www.indems.org. The voters of Maryland have spoken. Now we gotta deliver.
#
Derek,
This year, the fate of the Senate is going to be decided by just a few races in some key states. We’ve just heard from the Democratic voters of Maryland who have officially nominated their candidate for the U.S. Senate.
Congratulations to **Angela Alsobrooks** on winning the Maryland primary!
I am confident that Angela will be elected to the Senate in November, but we’ve still got one more hurdle to make that goal a reality. Angela is going to need our support to make it across the finish line.
**[So Derek, will you step up at this important moment by making a $5 donation to help elect Angela to the Senate in November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240515-1?refcode=em20240515-1-9009&refcode2=9009_434096_4AFBJx&akid=9009%2E434096%2E4AFBJx)**

There’s a lot on the line in Maryland. Not only will this race help decide the majority in the Senate, Angela is going to face off against the GOP’s candidate – Larry Hogan.
**Larry and his friends at the GOP want to turn back the clock in some major ways — starting with a federal abortion ban.** Let’s not forget: Hogan is the same person who vetoed a bill to expand abortion access in 2022.

❤️ John

clean_body: = Hi Friends — = Let me level with you. Running this movement takes a lot of resources and support, and truthfully, we have seen a massive fundraising slowdown this quarter. Tonight at midnight marks the halfway point of the month, and at this point, we want to be about 40% to our fundraising goal. But, unfortunately, we are only 31% there so far. That’s not great. Not reaching our goals means we have to cut back on our most impactful campaign investments — including supporting other House candidates in vulnerable seats that will determine the House majority — and we, as a country, cannot afford that. So I am reaching out to you today asking you to support my re-election campaign so we can continue to protect this seat and help other Democrats win races across the country. = = I’m so thankful that I can count on you to have my back. body:
The Virginia Budget Passed. What you need to know.
| | | |
VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION
BUDGET DEAL PASSED MONDAY
WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW

---
|
---
| | [LISTEN LIVE TO 1140 WRVA](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001haM_Wl3JLtvZgE2HBwEMdwETcvHDuWzM0CLlylUa0r6wJ7DhYSLJLdPkjkcUlxq_JGJqFOvMkCiH9b1--BQafnJaRC5mT8O56BJc7_2pstjwsraGByZ-6J61i_KYzZdCMUoKGVa9GcX1srmR1lImxVZotG-nLD6FIkdP5aryBqW_aLoOe9LrtafMLev1RkB8U4gBNT34DTGyO_Oqxj0-cg==&c=diuZPaBPYPFe-YblhbK9OhSrJPRu2CCRjv83i3fIB9kOGUyBB5tBVQ==&ch=wqu0E7aFAAz6WVcyPKSnCxAkKMHcOjlsyC1Nmdo6oL0en8JPOHYb2w==)
---
---
|
# TUNE IN THURSDAY, MAY 16 at 7:05AM
---
| Friends, If I had a vote on Virginia's budget on Monday, I would have voted "no." Why?
Way too much spending.
Why isn't anyone talking about how much spending the General Assembly has voted to increase the budget year after year to the tune of a whopping $20 billion over the past 4 years? That's a 20% increase. It's a 234% increase since FY2010. Wow.
While I understand the challenges of inflation, especially under Biden, it's time to ask legislators why they keep voting for budgets with out of control spending.
Just take a look at Virginia's operating expenses alone which for perspective were almost $38 billion in FY2010. They increased to $67 billion in FY2021 and now the budget that was approved on Monday at $87.5 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026.
Are you kidding me?
It's time to re-evaluate and re-prioritize all of the spending of our taxpayer dollars and look at ways to trim programs that aren't constitutionally mandated and are a waste of taxpayer dollars.
The Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year FY2025-2026 budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. That's $87 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026, almost a $20 billion or 20% increase in 4 years.
The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate.
A huge kudos and thank you to the unsung heroes who voted "no" on this bloated budget full of increased spending.
That said, we had to have a budget so our state wouldn't face a shutdown, which would have taken place on July 1, 2024. Yes, I hear you. There are agencies in the state government that I would like to see shut down as well, but there are also core functions of government that we must fund or it will effect public safety.
The reality is that the legislature is controlled by Democrats who like to spend and love governmental subsidized programs and subsidies. So Governor Youngkin and Republicans had to compromise. The governor didn't get the tax cuts he so strongly advocated for but thankfully there were also no new tax increases.
So here's the good news. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget.
Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026.
The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills.
There's much controversy over the operation of skill games in Virginia. While many small businesses and convenience stores say they desperately need these profits to stay afloat, many like myself are concerned about families and the addiction that entraps so many low income at risk families who are desperate to escape poverty, only to find they lose more money than they gain, further leaving the most vulnerable even more destitute. For reasons that I don't understand, this issue alone is a very heated debate and hot topic that has reached new heights in the General Assembly. Go figure. I don't get it.
The budget scrapped nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025 and ticked off many convienience store owners. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia.
Of all of the issues facing Virginians I can't figure out for the life of me why this single issue seems to have become one of the hottest issues that is before the General Assembly.
The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget. Why? So they can further debate and discuss how to handle skill games in Virginia. I can personally think of many higher priority issues, but it does appear the General Assembly will return to rehash skill games.
I personally don't believe it's worth bringing legislators back to Richmond for the sole purpose of addressing skill games in Virginia. In my humble opinion, it can wait until the 2025 legislative session in January.
By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to discuss potentially giving all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction. Another reason, the General Assembly should not meet again until January. More taxes on Virginians could be passed.
It concerns me that even some Republicans are interested in raising taxes locally to cover school construction. If a locality is struggling, then taxing the people in that area will only make matters worse. Instead cut some of these well intended commemorative programs and celebrations and let's find money in the budget to help these struggling schools.

The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees.
We're facing a major teacher shortage in Virginia, so I support doing anything to attract and retain good teachers. That said, where is the money in education going? Is it in fact going to teachers?
It increases state funding of K-12 schools by more than $2 billion and provides more than $200 million to make higher education more affordable by curbing tuition increases.
The approved budget boosts spending for Medicaid and rates paid to personal care attendants and expands services for Virginians with behavioral health disabilities.
The deal provides almost $145 million for the Washington transit system, $100 million in toll relief for drivers in Hampton Roads and, contingent on additional revenue, $175 million for improvements to Interstate 81 in western Virginia.
Why not get rid of the tolls in Hampton Roads? No wonder the people of Hampton need relief. You can't travel 10 miles before you have to pay a toll in Hampton. Does it surprise you that the city of Hampton is controlled by Democrats who voted in favor of the tolls? Sounds like a mismanagement issue to me. Maybe a call to Senators Louis Lucas and Maime Locke would be a good start. To support toll roads and then ask for relief is backwards to say the least.
Finally, the legislature elected eight judges, including three from [Hanover County, David Caddell Jr. ](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001haM_Wl3JLtvZgE2HBwEMdwETcvHDuWzM0CLlylUa0r6wJ7DhYSLJLdPkjkcUlxq_ibuRCL7Z1nQjVviVbImqrToWobgyJYY1s0cJBhVYSSnfs8tjIRsrl50QhEcSwMSbAFznya8R8lJrlD5-aSlJZWWL_qcsUcRKNy3f01JtPM4_xkNX9YIwxQ==&c=diuZPaBPYPFe-YblhbK9OhSrJPRu2CCRjv83i3fIB9kOGUyBB5tBVQ==&ch=wqu0E7aFAAz6WVcyPKSnCxAkKMHcOjlsyC1Nmdo6oL0en8JPOHYb2w==)and [Robert Reibach](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001haM_Wl3JLtvZgE2HBwEMdwETcvHDuWzM0CLlylUa0r6wJ7DhYSLJLdPkjkcUlxq_ZNG9zP4luKJy0YscffB9Ia-GfnclcsGKACP-o5JeI48SKDIw8s_2GNqhJOAhusCxs-tYqfnhvjpvAWWL2UokG5vD3xGlnnIQQpbqEcSjd7Focx-J8RmsZQ==&c=diuZPaBPYPFe-YblhbK9OhSrJPRu2CCRjv83i3fIB9kOGUyBB5tBVQ==&ch=wqu0E7aFAAz6WVcyPKSnCxAkKMHcOjlsyC1Nmdo6oL0en8JPOHYb2w==), for eight year terms on the circuit court for the 15th Judicial District; and Lisa Sewell, for a six-year term on the juvenile and domestic relations court for the 15th District.

What you need to know. | | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY SPECIAL SESSION BUDGET DEAL PASSED MONDAY WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW | | | == | TUNE IN THURSDAY, MAY 16 at 7:05AM | Friends, If I had a vote on Virginia's budget on Monday, I would have voted "no." Why? Way too much spending. Why isn't anyone talking about how much spending the General Assembly has voted to increase the budget year after year to the tune of a whopping $20 billion over the past 4 years? That's a 20% increase. It's a 234% increase since FY2010. Wow. While I understand the challenges of inflation, especially under Biden, it's time to ask legislators why they keep voting for budgets with out of control spending. Just take a look at Virginia's operating expenses alone which for perspective were almost $38 billion in FY2010. They increased to $67 billion in FY2021 and now the budget that was approved on Monday at $87.5 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026. Are you kidding me? It's time to re-evaluate and re-prioritize all of the spending of our taxpayer dollars and look at ways to trim programs that aren't constitutionally mandated and are a waste of taxpayer dollars. The Virginia General Assembly passed a $188 billion two year FY2025-2026 budget, which will go into effect July 1, 2024. That's $87 billion in FY2025 and $89 billion in FY2026, almost a $20 billion or 20% increase in 4 years. The House vote was 94-6 with "no" votes from conservatives Freitas, Garrett, Griffin, Oates, Scott, P.A., and Zehr. The Senate vote was 39-1, with McGuire casting the only true conservative "no" vote in the Senate. A huge kudos and thank you to the unsung heroes who voted "no" on this bloated budget full of increased spending. That said, we had to have a budget so our state wouldn't face a shutdown, which would have taken place on July 1, 2024. Yes, I hear you. There are agencies in the state government that I would like to see shut down as well, but there are also core functions of government that we must fund or it will effect public safety. The reality is that the legislature is controlled by Democrats who like to spend and love governmental subsidized programs and subsidies. So Governor Youngkin and Republicans had to compromise. The governor didn't get the tax cuts he so strongly advocated for but thankfully there were also no new tax increases. So here's the good news. The proposal to increase the state's sales tax to cover digital purchases like streaming subscriptions, music downloads and software was struck from the budget. Democrats didn't get priorities like legalizing retail sales of marijuana for recreational use and raising the state's minimum wage to $15 per hour by 2026. The best news is that the budget won't be linked to RGGI. This program requires electricity producers to purchase allowances for the carbon they emit, and some money raised from those purchases is returned to Virginia and used for flood resiliency and energy efficiency efforts. RGGI is a backdoor tax on Virginians because it allows companies to recoup the costs through customers' energy bills. There's much controversy over the operation of skill games in Virginia. While many small businesses and convenience stores say they desperately need these profits to stay afloat, many like myself are concerned about families and the addiction that entraps so many low income at risk families who are desperate to escape poverty, only to find they lose more money than they gain, further leaving the most vulnerable even more destitute. For reasons that I don't understand, this issue alone is a very heated debate and hot topic that has reached new heights in the General Assembly. Go figure. I don't get it. The budget scrapped nearly $94 million in skill game revenue anticipated for fiscal year 2025 and ticked off many convienience store owners. The legislature will probably meet again before the year is out to address how to handle skill games in Virginia. Of all of the issues facing Virginians I can't figure out for the life of me why this single issue seems to have become one of the hottest issues that is before the General Assembly. The House and Senate both went into recess after acting on the budget, rather than adjourn. So they are not still not finished for the year, despite passing a budget. Why? So they can further debate and discuss how to handle skill games in Virginia. I can personally think of many higher priority issues, but it does appear the General Assembly will return to rehash skill games. I personally don't believe it's worth bringing legislators back to Richmond for the sole purpose of addressing skill games in Virginia. In my humble opinion, it can wait until the 2025 legislative session in January. By going into recess instead of adjourning for the year, the legislature can call itself back into session to discuss potentially giving all localities the option of raising the sales tax on themselves to pay for school construction. Another reason, the General Assembly should not meet again until January. More taxes on Virginians could be passed. It concerns me that even some Republicans are interested in raising taxes locally to cover school construction. If a locality is struggling, then taxing the people in that area will only make matters worse. Instead cut some of these well intended commemorative programs and celebrations and let's find money in the budget to help these struggling schools. | The budget compromise includes raises of 3% each year for teachers, state employees and state-supported local employees. name: AOC Organizing Team
subject: Do you have plans this Sunday?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Join us this Sunday at 5:30 PM ET!
#
We are committed to being a different kind of political campaign: we want to let you know about ways you can directly help grow our progressive movement — and that includes important organizing opportunities.
Today, we're reaching out because **we could really use your help connecting with progressive voters across Alexandria's district** this election year.
[If you can, will you join us this Sunday to speak with our neighbors, so we can send Alexandria back to Congress to keep fighting for all of us?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/25394?utm_source=em20240515-6415&t=1&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/25394?utm_source=em20240515-6415&t=2&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
[Join us on Sunday at 5:30PM → ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/25394?utm_source=em20240515-6415&t=3&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
We will be calling residents of Alexandria's district to talk about key issues, the 2024 election, and Alexandria's work in Congress. And you can help our organizing efforts from anywhere in the U.S. — **all you need is a computer and internet.**
Never done phonebanking before? No worries! We begin every session with a training to make sure everyone has what they need to be successful, and **you won’t be on the phonebank alone.**
[Alexandria's primary election is in just 41 days. Will you join us this Sunday to help us build organizing power for the long-term through voter outreach?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/25394?utm_source=em20240515-6415&t=4&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
[RSVP](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/25394?utm_source=em20240515-6415&t=5&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
We’re organizing year-round — both locally and nationally — to build long-term organizing power with our neighbors and allies.
Thank you for standing with us. Alexandria's work is _only_ possible because of you.
We hope to see you Sunday!
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ocasio-campaign?refcode=em20240515-6415-P_ORG_VOL_ORG&t=6&refcode2=6415_2526796_oYJ4Bo&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20240515-6415-P_ORG_VOL_ORG&t=7&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)**
---|---
[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=8&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=9&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=10&akid=6415%2E2526796%2EoYJ4Bo)
---|---|---
Email us: [speak@ocasiocortez.com](mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

Untitled Document

Please read the
following message from our sponsor.

If you've been led to believe
that peanut butter, almonds and spinach are good for you, today's
email might shock you and is important to read, because these 3
healthy foods could be contributing to health problems in your
body.

Let's take a quick look at why...

1. Peanut butter

While peanut butter does contain
a small amount of protein and vitamins/minerals, the cons
outweigh the pros on this food.

First of all, peanuts contain one
of the highest concentrations of aflatoxin, which is a mold toxin
that is created in peanuts due to storage in moist conditions.

Peanut butter is also very high
in inflammatory omega-6 fats and due to the processing of peanut
butter, those omega 6 fats are in a harmful oxidized state.

Most people already get too much
omega 6 fats from vegetable oils (soy, corn, canola, etc), and
this contributes to insulin resistance, heart disease, brain
inflammation, cancer, and lots more health problems, since most
people are currently eating 5-10x more omega-6 fats than we
should be eating in a healthy diet.

Lastly, peanut butter also
contains medium amounts of oxalates, which are plant-based
antinutrients that when consumed in excess can contribute to
kidney stones, thyroid and gut problems, joint problems and more.

We'll talk more about oxalates in
the next food...

2. Spinach

Spinach is promoted as a healthy
green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides. Spinach
is one of the highest oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by
modern humans (in addition to beet greens, beets, almonds, and
other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl.

The "safe" amount of oxalates in
a daily diet according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally
Norton should be between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot
of the health problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So, you can see how concerning
spinach is with the extremely high oxalate levels.

As mentioned above, eating too
much oxalates too frequently can cause serious issues such as
kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by eating green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

3. Almonds

Although almonds and almond milk
are marketed as healthy, they also contain many downsides,
including all of the negatives mentioned above about too much
omega 6 fats and too much oxalates.

They're probably ok in your diet
occasionally, but I personally avoid eating almonds too often
because of these issues with excess oxalates and omega 6 fats.

Now let's take a look at a fun
little quiz below and a few more foods...

Bananas vs oranges vs apples...
(the #1 WORST fruit for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one fruit people over 40 should never eat.

This fruit can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones. Both sapping you of energy and forcing
your body to create "sticky" fat cells that can NOT be "burned
off" with normal diet and exercise.

Do you know the fruit I'm talking
about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you think it
is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the next page:

>> Bananas

>> Oranges

>> Apples

>> Grapes

_**This is a win for West Virginia.**_

_**This is a win for Conservative Republicans nationwide.**_

As the Trump-endorsed, America-First candidate our fight doesn't stop here. I will continue to fight for our values and way of life. We will stop the radical Left from hurting our country by building a strong Republican Senate Majority.

| **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. In addition, they have three dogs: Lucy and Ellie, Boston Terriers, and their famous Babydog, an English Bulldog.

But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.

As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.

Peter, In just a moment, we’re going to ask if you can spare any amount to support Governor Kotek’s work before our mid-quarter deadline tonight. We’ll explain why this is so important, but if you want to cut to the chase, [_**you can make a donation of any amount right here**._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85007173/473357452/1000513557?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_MQG_AC_20240515_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOWEyNWNmMy1lYTEyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tt41WXTj51_b4360KVM8LTvpqFalpuP9zRGvnupjRcQ=) Mid-quarter fundraising deadlines are benchmarks that we use to make sure we’re on track to raise the resources needed to support our shared priorities and connect with Oregonians. When we come up short on fundraising goals, it’s not the end of the world. The sky won’t fall, and we’re not going to use any scare tactics to convince you to pitch in. #

Peter, it’s official: I just won the Maryland U.S. Senate Democratic primary and will be taking on Republican Larry Hogan in November.
Make no mistake, Larry Hogan won’t be easy to beat. He was handpicked by Mitch McConnell and his MAGA allies have already started pouring in millions of dollars to defeat me.
**The GOP’s plan to take back the Senate majority hinges on Maryland.** That’s why I need your help stopping them starting right now.
[**My team has a 10,000 General Election Founding Donor Goal that we must hit within the next week to have the resources to start the general on the right foot. Will you chip in a split grassroots donation right now between my campaign and Ruben Gallego to become a General Election Founding Donor?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-alsobrooks-split.fPKdZW&refcode=em240515-2-30&t=1&akid=2333%2E734936%2ERPjNFB)

As Prince George’s County Executive and a former state’s attorney, I’ve spent my career fighting on behalf of Maryland families. In the Senate, I’ll be a strong voice in support of abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.
But, my Republican opponent Larry Hogan? He’s working against our Maryland values.
As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.
On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.
The simple truth is this: Mitch McConnell is banking on flipping this seat and using Hogan’s vote to pass a national abortion ban, destroy Social Security and Medicare, and give tax breaks to MAGA big money donors.
I look forward to making sure every Maryland voter knows just how dangerous Larry Hogan would be in the U.S. Senate. But, we need resources immediately to start putting his feet to the fire.

As Governor, he vetoed a $15 minimum wage, common sense gun legislation, and access to increased reproductive and abortion care in Maryland.

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.

body:
# [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85010671/473368028/18334046?refcode=UTS_FR_90DO_240515_2_2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcyMjFkOWIwLWVmMTItZWYxMS05NmYzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Lt7oD8Z2e_5NBAQWvqCR4o_rDaKhnGELEf4SnX1deW8=)
Peter—

This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country.

The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this.

There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done.

Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7.

Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.

I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done.

That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me:

“Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson
“Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump
“[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy

Never in my life would I expect to be cast a president’s “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down.

It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump.

There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty.

But like I said on the House floor, I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office.

My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever.

After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. I have a record of getting tough things done, and I’m ready to do the hard work needed for our families, for our economy, for our democracy, and for our planet.

[**It’s clear Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are going to do everything they can to sabotage my campaign — because they know how effective I am at gathering the truth, making a case, and holding them accountable. I need your help to overcome their attacks. clean_body: = Peter— This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country. The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this. There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done. Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7. Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States. I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done. That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me: “Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson “Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump “[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy Never in my life would I expect to be cast a president’s “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down. It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump. There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty. But like I said on the House floor, I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office. My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever. After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. Friend,

**Three years ago, the Spirit of Virginia was asleep.**

Our great Commonwealth was falling behind under extreme, failed policies that made the cost of living unaffordable, kept parents out of their children's lives, and forced people to move away from Virginia.

But then something amazing happened. In 2021, the Spirit of Virginia woke back up. Virginians across the political divide made a decision to change direction and we haven't looked back since.

We went from the bottom of the country in job growth to near the top of the list. Virginians are keeping more of their hard-earned money, and we're lowering the cost of living. Parents are back in control of their children's education and upbringing.

Our teachers and law enforcement are getting the pay and support they deserve. We're transforming our behavioral health system to get Virginians the right help right now.

We're proving that commonsense, conservative leadership works.

_And now, the Spirit of Virginia is stronger than ever before._

Friend, when I first met Kirsten Gillibrand, she was a young lawyer running for Congress in a district with more cows than Democrats.
Defeating a deeply entrenched GOP incumbent in a tough red district is no easy task. Truthfully, there weren't many people who thought she could pull it off. **But on election night in 2006, people everywhere learned to never — _ever_ — count Kirsten out.** (For the record, I'm proud to be one of her earliest believers.)
Since that first election, Kirsten has proven herself time and time again as a fierce, bold advocate for families around America. The minute she was sworn in as our junior senator, I gained an incredible partner. During our time serving in the Senate, we've worked together on countless pieces of legislation, secured millions in federal funding for vital social programs and proudly fought for progress as a united team.
**As Kirsten's colleague and friend —** _and as our Senate majority_** **_leader_**— take it from me: We need Kirsten's voice in the Senate.** But following a red wave in New York in 2022, Republicans are already targeting her seat for defeat.

Together, we secured long overdue reforms to our military justice system — ensuring that our service members can seek justice without fear of retaliation. **Now, Kirsten is fighting to guarantee paid family leave for all Americans and** _**finally**_**add the Equal Rights Amendment to the Constitution.**
Kirsten is getting the job done — and Republicans are taking notice. They know how much of a threat Kirsten is to their far-right agenda. That's why they'll do everything within their power to defeat her.
New York Republicans celebrated their best election cycle in decades in 2022. Their extremist candidates flipped enough seats in the midterms to win control of the House. Now, they're trying to defeat Kirsten to take back the Senate too.
I know that Kirsten has what it takes to overcome the odds and defeat whichever radical right-wing extremist runs against her — she's done it before. name: Patrick Dillon for Team Stein
subject: I am a former foster child and a survivor. This is my story.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_foster_care&n=1)
---
Peter,

May is National Foster Care Month. As a former foster youth, I’d like to take a moment to tell you my story.

This is a difficult story to share – and it’s long – but it’s important. Because the abuse I suffered and the struggles my family faced were _all_ avoidable.

**Some of the content may be triggering for survivors of abuse and sexual violence.** If you need to skip to the end of this email, I’m going to talk about how Jill’s policies will reduce the number of children in crisis by addressing the root cause of inequality.

I was born into a highly unstable household. My mother was on disability for severe mental illness. My father was a raging alcoholic and an abuser. When we managed to escape my father, it was not the end of the abuse – just the start of a horrible new chapter.

My early childhood was defined by the massive gaps in our social safety net. If not for the kindness of strangers, local food banks, and mom’s monthly Social Security check, I don’t know how we would have survived.

But mom also had a string of abusive boyfriends. So, I started looking for creative ways to stay out of the home by taking odd jobs around our apartment complex – cleaning up trash, walking dogs for seniors, that sort of thing.

Left to roam without supervision, I was targeted by an employee of the apartment complex who repeatedly sexually abused me. After some time, the abuser offered to pay my mother for custody of me. We were so broke that she accepted his deal.

**Once he and his partner had unrestricted access to me, the abuse got immeasurably worse. I didn’t think I would survive it. I wasn’t sure I wanted to survive it.

** Somehow, someone noticed what was happening and called CPS. I was taken to a foster care center in Las Vegas, NV. They performed a rape kit and shuffled me into a massive dormitory where I shared a single bathroom with 30 other boys. I stayed there in shock for 74 days.

Eventually I got to live with a foster family. They were wonderful, loving people, and I will forever be grateful for them. But I was still a deeply traumatized child (now teen) living with other deeply traumatized children.

In the 5 years I spent in foster homes, I attempted suicide twice. I moved around and changed schools so often it was impossible to maintain friendships.

Moving from school to school also meant I was constantly losing credits, so I didn’t get a high school graduation. I never got a cap and gown or had the chance to walk across the stage and receive a diploma while my family cheered me on.

**But I survived. Even though I wasn’t sure I wanted to.

** My life today is very different. I was able to get my GED. I’ve built a career I’m proud of. I have an amazing partner who is my rock and from whom I draw courage every day.

I am a survivor of childhood abuse and sexual assault. I still have PTSD. I still suffer the nightmares, the panic attacks, the hypervigilance. I will carry that trauma for as long as I live. It’s a part of me, but it does not define me.

**This work, what we are doing with this campaign, this is how I want to define my life.

** The timing of this message with the release of **[Jill’s platform](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_foster_care&n=2)** couldn’t be more perfect. What Jill and all of us on the team are fighting for are the solutions that will reduce the number of children in crisis.

**Neither Republicans nor Democrats are serious about addressing these issues.** Republicans want to completely eliminate the Social Security disability payments that kept my mother and me alive. Democrats want to means-test everything to death, to calculate just how poor and desperate people have to be to “qualify” for basic human dignity.

Jill’s economic bill of rights, her pledge to guarantee housing and healthcare (including mental healthcare) as a human right, her disability rights platform and a whole lot more would have saved me from a childhood of constant cycles of abuse and a lifetime of trauma.

**There are 7 million American children receiving federal assistance right now. There are at least 360,000 in foster care at any given time. It’s not too late for us to save them.

** I’m so proud to be part of this team. We are working our hearts out to put justice on the ballot this November.

**If you’re still reading, thank you.

** Thank you for listening to my story. Thank you for supporting this campaign. Thank you for being in the fight.

**If this message moved you or inspired you, I ask that you make a contribution to Jill’s campaign today so that we can continue this work******
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_foster_care&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_foster_care&n=3)
---
Throughout everything that happened, at every step of the way, there were always people looking out for me. It is because of them that I’m still here.

I want to honor them by amplifying that effort on a national scale by electing a president who will always fight for people, planet, and peace.

Thank you again for listening. If you have a story you’d be willing to share about how [**Jill’s policies**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=_foster_care&n=4) would impact your life, we would love to hear from you. You can leave a message below.

---
In solidarity,

Patrick Dillon
Deputy National Field Director
Team Jill Stein 2024

| **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. In addition, they have three dogs: Lucy and Ellie, Boston Terriers, and their famous Babydog, an English Bulldog.

| | **For Immediate Release:** May 15, 2023
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**End Citizens United // Let America Vote Endorses Dave Min for Congress**
**IRVINE, CA** — Dave Min, a staunch advocate for removing Big Money from politics, has proudly received the endorsement of End Citizens United // Let America Vote. Unlike his opponent, Scott Baugh, whose career has been marred by allegations of corruption, Dave has committed to not accepting a single dollar of corporate PAC money, ensuring his accountability to the people of Orange County alone, not special interests.

**“As we face unprecedented threats against our democracy, we need strong leaders who will stand up for the people while in Congress—and Dave Min is that leader,”** said Tiffany Muller, President of End Citizens United // Let America Vote.**“He knows our democracy cannot work unless every voice is heard, not just special interests —that’s why he’s refusing to take a dime of corporate PAC money. Orange County families can trust Dave to fight for the issues that are most pressing to them, like protecting abortion rights, getting rid of Big Money’s influence in politics, and lowering the price of prescription drugs. We are excited to endorse Dave and look forward to helping him win.” **

As a state senator, Min introduced legislation to protect Californians from unlawful voter ID requirements, to ensure that every person was able to exercise one of their most fundamental freedoms. He also introduced anti-corruption legislation that would bar public officials from granting government contracts to family members. He supports federal protections such as the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. He believes that Congress must shine a light on the dark money in our political system and firmly supports legislation that would create more transparency and accountability, like the DISCLOSE Act.

**“Campaign finance is fundamentally broken in America today,”** said State Senator Dave Min. **“The flood of special interest dark money and pay-to-play politics at the highest levels of our government— including Supreme Court Justices, U.S. Senators, and former Presidents— have undermined public trust in the integrity of our political institutions. We must strengthen and reinvigorate our democracy, and that starts by electing people who will stand up to dark money and special interests. I’m proud to be the only candidate in this race who is not taking corporate PAC money, and I’m grateful for the endorsements of End Citizens United // Let America Vote.”**

Before his time as a State Senator, Dave Min served at the Securities and Exchange Committee and in Senator Chuck Schumer’s office, where he focused on financial regulation and anti-corruption measures. His extensive experience crafting legislation to enhance transparency and accountability in government starkly contrasts with the troubled legal history of his Republican opponent, Scott Baugh. Previously, Baugh was [charged with multiple felonies and misdemeanors](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=4576bbbb59&e=7017cc100e), [accused of campaign finance violations](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bc0c70d8c3&e=7017cc100e) and of [convincing his campaign treasurer to commit perjury](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ee688ee57b&e=7017cc100e). He also sponsored legislation aimed at easing the burden on white-collar defendants, including a bill that allowed them to have their lawyers present during grand jury testimonies—a move criticized by [then-State Senator Adam Schiff as a "bill of rights for white-collar defendants."](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=0c16e017b1&e=7017cc100e) Additionally, Baugh [pushed for a bill that would require prosecutors to disclose exculpatory evidence in grand jury cases](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7504d7173c&e=7017cc100e), a measure that was [alleged to benefit him personally](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=65457ddeb6&e=7017cc100e). ### _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

name: Wes Moore
subject: We did it, Maryland
body:
Friend, we did it!

Last night, Angela Alsobrooks officially became our Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Maryland.

I am honored to not only call Angela a friend, but also the best choice to represent Maryland’s interests in the Senate. Let me tell you why I’m supporting Angela for the Senate.

In our Maryland, we have lowered homicides, made historic investments in education, brought record-low unemployment to the state, and signed some of the strongest laws in America to project reproductive freedoms. Angela has been a partner every step of the way.

As the State’s Attorney, Angela oversaw a 50% reduction in violent crime, built 10 new schools, and helped secure the new FBI Headquarters for our state. She is also a strong advocate for abortion rights, equality, education, and economic opportunity.

Angela understands that this is Maryland’s decade and that in our Maryland, we don’t leave anyone behind.
We need our next Senator to work hard to deliver results. Angela is the best choice to beat Larry Hogan in November. With her as a partner in the Senate, I know that we can accomplish so much more for Maryland, and the whole country.

We’re going to do everything we can to elect Angela, but we need your support. She’s going to need all of us over the next six months to defeat Larry Hogan in November. Please, make a donation to ensure Angela Alsobrooks becomes our next Senator. 100% of your donation goes to Angela’s campaign. Elevate,
Wes

# Biden and Trump are set to debate...
This morning, President Biden released a video responding to President Trump’s multiple requests to debate. Trump, who has made it clear he would debate Biden anytime, anywhere, immediately agreed to debate—despite Biden’s ridiculous demand that no third-party candidates (read RFK Jr.) be permitted and that it occur without an audience in the studio of one of the friendly left-wing media outlets dominated by former Democrat operatives.
The first debate is scheduled for June 27th on CNN, and the second is scheduled for September 10th on ABC—talk about a home-field advantage for Biden. Tonight on the show, I will share my take on these debates.
[Subscribe and hit the notification button](https://seanspicer.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d009170fb4604b5974b5521bd&id=ef204ee030&e=f6564bbe3b)
# Are battleground states expanding?
After Trump’s massive rally in New Jersey over the weekend, one of his pollsters Jim McLaughlin, joined me to share the state of play in the battleground states and his views on how that map will expand (hint, he thinks Minnesota and Virginia will be in play and has the numbers to back it up). Also, Mark Halperin, who I think is one of the best-sourced journalists in the game, gives me his take on what he’s hearing from inside the campaigns.

_** **_ Fellow Conservative,

Tim Sheehy needs your help to win this race. He has already fallen millions of dollars behind, and Jon Tester is widening the gap with his massive checks from tech billionaires, D.C. special interests, and lobbyists.

What's worse? Tim contacted you about this critical final deadline before our June 4th primary election, _**and he has yet to hear back.**_

_**↓↓ I’ve forwarded his message below. ↓↓**_

Please review his message and rejoin the fight to defeat Jon Tester and reclaim the Senate!

Thank you,
Team Sheehy

\---------- Forwarded message ---------

From: Tim Sheehy
Date: Tue, May 14, 2024 at 11:43 AM
Subject: Tomorrow’s FEC deadline
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com

Fellow Conservative,

I’m unsure if you’re aware, but tomorrow marks the final FEC fundraising deadline ahead of Montana’s June 4th primary. And quite frankly, I hoped to be in a better spot.

Why?

Because getting dollars in the door this month has been tough. My finance team tells me it’s typical for fundraising to begin taking off as Election Day draws nearer, but that hasn’t happened for us. For a while, things seem to be sorting themselves out. We raised a decent amount of money in March and April, but once May rolled around, our numbers went downhill.

**But don’t take my word for it. I made the chart above to show how dramatically our fundraising has fallen off.**
[**CHIP IN $3 ->** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=596b4cb9b2d446b0aa7a86b6cc7da1f2&_e=roZzXvWCv8lvK2yGiKLyyiQGHOEQCwuGScZvL5BxnO3csJtWIEcvxWfw6oXxQ9HRF91jedRUX0ATdBUIZ_aVQiInvuH-R75LazTMm4GiU7leQuk-mrzQ7tjMbVc9G1-luoih5Gf5gfhk27idyon8Zed5FA7-6POShH8FQJi_RFzgNYUjBYrxfexIiNxm37xhtnJkRtgNIReFeaiJPk8L4nepivzK6XMTB3hpfJ9PvSLDjFhmBfGTxWxjb8-7_7RMGiACrt34tJuSqISuF1EvGq4SUjSxK5-lSxHQ1EeDmRdQzz-bXoodxS1yhN0BM1YkRxficlKhRHesOURm4TdX8ipzrDiES2hDUukExWoAoBcs7dk9na0m6hURyVxb0ie_Pgmgxp4-uEvYcv15cwlamYK19elh43YNt6Jy7oCr9w8%3D)
Each value in the chart above represents how much my team raised in the first 15 days of each month so far in 2024.

Things were on the up and up through March , then we began to slide backward.

**I’m using bullet points because you must realize the precarious situation my team and I are in:**

* When we missed our April fundraising goal, I emailed our list of supporters, explaining how my campaign had been outraised by more than $5 million in Q1 and is regularly outraised by my opponent five to one. I’m not sure whether folks like you received my note, but to say say that request fell short is an understatement. **My plea for help raised just $931. ->[link to donate](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=596b4cb9b2d446b0aa7a86b6cc7da1f2&_e=roZzXvWCv8lvK2yGiKLyyiQGHOEQCwuGScZvL5BxnO3csJtWIEcvxWfw6oXxQ9HRF91jedRUX0ATdBUIZ_aVQiInvuH-R75LazTMm4GiU7leQuk-mrzQ7tjMbVc9G1-luoih5Gf5gfhk27idyon8Zed5FA7-6POShH8FQJi_RFzgNYUjBYrxfexIiNxm37xhtnJkRtgNIReFeaiJPk8L4nepivzK6XMTB3hpfJ9PvSLDjFhmBfGTxWxjb8-7_7RMGiACrt34tJuSqISuF1EvGqxk9ej5na4GFuXBE9EwvthlOuN9Vq4Qeef1pn4vtn7cG3vQzfik15zHXjNwgiDcbzxdbM4AEWS2cqbthtVhsfegXu6hyi_jRRLNWcoPdlHckcBodAOzZpDoluFxBBqpP4d-C7FMe8WIM-JxN41Z95Y%3D) **

* We’re ahead in the polls, but it’s a statistical tie. The most recent national survey showed me leading my progressive opponent, Jon Tester, by 3%. **But in polling terms, this race is anyone’s to win or lose.**

* Republicans need to flip one seat to win the Senate majority. That might sound easy, but entrenched incumbents, like Jon Tester, don’t have plans to lose, and they’re raising RECORD sums of money to buy themselves another term in office. -> **[link to donate](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=596b4cb9b2d446b0aa7a86b6cc7da1f2&_e=roZzXvWCv8lvK2yGiKLyyiQGHOEQCwuGScZvL5BxnO3csJtWIEcvxWfw6oXxQ9HRF91jedRUX0ATdBUIZ_aVQiInvuH-R75LazTMm4GiU7leQuk-mrzQ7tjMbVc9G1-luoih5Gf5gfhk27idyon8Zed5FA7-6POShH8FQJi_RFzgNYUjBYrxfexIiNxm37xhtnJkRtgNIReFeaiJPk8L4nepivzK6XMTB3hpfJ9PvSLDjFhmBfGTxWxjb8-7_7RMGiACrt34tJuSqISuF1EvGkyXvodruecwPodT_9MmyjdRV8Mlj6MvjOpUz3AurG8Na7Jxp522AjcTALP_UmRn9XlgTr1mqbXTR91d9yGPRpyucFbeJe_KW2LArHDmWS5fbxDvqDBAtBgKR-GFfLzNQhRkhzSCGiLG0UALu0cGjVs%3D)**

Despite all his years in the public eye, he is not a good communicator. And if he hopes to win reelection, his team needs to change course quickly. He needs to adopt a strategy that puts the focus squarely on what he hopes to accomplish if elected to a second term.

This could take the form of very capable people around him who may serve in his cabinet or economic advisors who have the credibility to get out there and help change the narrative.

I'm not sure if it’s the president or his team that is in denial about what's going on or about what’s failing to get through to Americans. But it seems clear there is a big disconnect between what he feels he's accomplished (and deserves credit for) and what the American people believe about the current state of our economy.

Not all of us will agree on this, I’m aware, because not everyone is thriving as they feel they should in today’s economy. But the reality is not as dire as many Americans tell the polls. We’d all be better served if the president and his team could improve their message. Tell us where we stand and where he plans to take us. His presidency – and America’s future – stand in the balance.

I’m out there doing what I can to tell it straight, so I appreciate your support – whatever you can do – to help me in that effort.

John
