clean_body: I've been asked a lot lately about what I think is going on with the disconnect so many Americans are feeling about President Biden’s economic message, and with the struggles his team is having with his lagging poll numbers.| | | Peter, I've been asked a lot lately about what I think is going on with the disconnect so many Americans are feeling about President Biden’s economic message, and with the struggles his team is having with his lagging poll numbers. As you know, I endorsed President Biden for election in 2020 because I believed that a second term for Donald Trump represented a clear threat to American democracy. I mention that so you’ll know that I take no joy in sharing with you the things I said on Monday during a CNBC interview. "Gov. John Kasich on CNBC Last Call" | | | | ---|---|---|--- Despite all his years in the public eye, he is not a good communicator. And if he hopes to win reelection, his team needs to change course quickly. He needs to adopt a strategy that puts the focus squarely on what he hopes to accomplish if elected to a second term. This could take the form of very capable people around him who may serve in his cabinet or economic advisors who have the credibility to get out there and help change the narrative. I'm not sure if it’s the president or his team that is in denial about what's going on or about what’s failing to get through to Americans. But it seems clear there is a big disconnect between what he feels he's accomplished (and deserves credit for) and what the American people believe about the current state of our economy. Not all of us will agree on this, I’m aware, because not everyone is thriving as they feel they should in today’s economy. But the reality is not as dire as many Americans tell the polls. We’d all be better served if the president and his team could improve their message. Tell us where we stand and where he plans to take us. His presidency – and America’s future – stand in the balance. I’m out there doing what I can to tell it straight, so I appreciate your support – whatever you can do – to help me in that effort. body:
I want to show you these hateful mailers Ken Calvert sent out about me

| Peter, when I first ran for Congress in 1994, I was **publicly outed as gay by my Republican opponent, Ken Calvert.**

**Today, I wanted to show you the exact mailers that were used:** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85015586/473381251/649527246?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240515_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Y0YTc3Yy1mODEyLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-10t4l-hZ9b8W6Fgsbq5ML3bZhY_smMkKFC16Jw2svg=) Peter, in a series of bright pink mailers, Ken Calvert – _a currently sitting US Congressman_ – **revealed my sexuality to thousands of Riverside residents without my consent.**

On the campaign trail, he has continually flip-flopped on the issues because he’s afraid to stand up to his party. He’s even called access to reproductive care an “emotional issue for women”.

body:
With our mid-month fundraising deadline hitting tonight, we’re in a make-or-break moment. So we’re writing to you with an urgent, critical request
#

Peter, we’re seeing a major downturn in our fundraising.
That downturn could not be coming at a worse time. If you’ve got a minute, please... let us explain why this is so dangerous for us.
For the last few months we’ve had really strong fundraising. We’ve outraised Kari Lake, we’ve had some strong showings in the polls, and we found ourselves in a strong position to win this election.
We made plans based on that performance. We reserved millions of dollars in advertising in the home stretch of the election — millions of dollars that we predicted we’d be able to raise, and millions that we’re on the hook for.
But our fundraising this month... it’s just not been great. We’re not sure why, but folks just aren’t giving like they used to.
And the timing — it’s absolutely terrible. Because not only are we on the hook for millions in ads, Kari Lake just announced that she is spending $10 million dollars on television against us.
**_TEN MILLION DOLLARS, Peter.**_
It’s huge. And if we’re not careful, that kind of advertising could swamp us. This is win-lose territory. And if we lose, that means Kari Lake in a Senate held by the Republicans.

| We did it team:**I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Maryland’s 2nd Congressional District!** My heartfelt thanks goes out to everyone who played a role in helping us decide this victory.

Serving our communities—first as a member of the House of Delegates and later as Baltimore County Executive—taught me that when we work together, there’s nothing that we can’t do.

Together, we’ve transformed what government can be, ensuring that our neighbors now drive the conversation about how to meet the needs of our community. It’s the same approach I’ll take as a member of Congress.

Too often, self-interest, special interests, and partisan politics get in the way of progress while hard-working families struggle with rising everyday costs.

With your continued support, I will be part of a new generation of leadership in Congress who understands how to make government work effectively and will use that knowledge to bring us together and improve people’s lives.

I want to talk about why we’re paying close attention to our grassroots fundraising performance right now, and [**why your first donation would be particularly meaningful today.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2194?t=8&akid=2172%2E4032634%2EEpQc4h) Our re-election campaign is funded by grassroots, small-dollar donations. In fact, 99% of the donations we’ve received this year have been $100 or less. That’s a testament to the strength of this truly grassroots-powered movement. And that's exactly the type of campaign I want to run. **But a few updates in our race have made us keep a close eye on our fundraising right now:**
* A new right-wing Super PAC just launched to target me and boost one of my GOP opponents. It’s got ties to the Trump administration, Mitch McConnell, and powerful corporate interests — from Big Oil to Big Pharma to the big banks.
* That same GOP challenger the Super PAC is supporting just recently announced that he’d invested $1 million of his own money into his campaign.
* A second Republican challenger with ties to wealthy special interests recently announced a campaign to run against me too.

I know our movement is stronger than the special interests supporting my opponents, but our grassroots fundraising model only works if everyone keeps pitching in whatever they can, whenever they can. [**So can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can today to ensure we can compete and continue fighting for working people in the Senate? We can’t afford to underestimate the amount of support my opponents can receive from national Republicans and outside special interests.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2194?amount=28&t=9&akid=2172%2E4032634%2EEpQc4h)

Friend, Today is Nakba Day, marking 76 years since the Nakba (“catastrophe” in Arabic), when nearly 800,000 Palestinians were violently forced from their homes during Israel’s creation in 1948. During that period of intense ethnic cleansing, 15,000 Palestinians were massacred and more than 500 villages were destroyed. **To this day, the Israeli government is still trying to erase an entire people.** Most of Gaza’s residents are refugees from the Nakba, and they’ve been forcibly displaced multiple times over the past 7 months. In this time, Israeli forces have killed over 35,000 Palestinians in Gaza and have committed many well-documented violations of the Genocide Convention under international law. Our country is actively participating in this genocide: Most of my colleagues in Congress are still voting to send Israel’s Prime Minister Netanyahu billions more in weapons without any conditions on upholding human rights. And across the country, many lawmakers are trying to criminalize criticism of Israel’s apartheid regime. **As part of my efforts to humanize Palestinians in Congress, I just re-introduced a resolution to commemorate the Nakba.** The resolution also calls on the United States to continue to support the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) and to support the implementation of Palestinian refugees’ internationally-recognized legal right to return to their homes, as enshrined in United Nations General Assembly Resolution 194 and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. [**On this Nakba Day, will you sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor of my resolution to recognize Palestinians’ human rights and the history of the Nakba?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38YIS_P_YcOYCCdM10KghjstneG3FaY7b1oheSNp7vGenGRnNhT8oPBux4CyerroXwInvoz-F4ZrGZO6brAN0QQBLTY4u4fsW0gCeWirwha10JK0kbvLCO5U8bh8_eOZY2XS1Vj2r_eriTYH-uPYpFhEsL_74Lu4V9uDYSJBtIK6Iog5khCBw42UemsG6RwZhhTCKyoLHlUJ-PIKRRDPsaG6vSl6cdLQ3wm8RFQOAERcu_ViPMKjhC5zQnflQd4oFy_WRDMb45m5nuv6KjWdbQrBz4ILopJky0Geza3gPeCM50FBnN8VDO0JdyL-LRoZbaYDZQOctzMDuYqKL8aSvf_xKXO34Rfbv2f2aBvxCRD6w/46d/Kyt1tY3QT7iaI-eQ0mv6dQ/h1/h001.LyEoQFwuAigl6gXtfaGQFsP8pm944fQ0Tsu287LQl4Y) One refugee from 1948’s Nakba, Mustafa al-Gazzar, is now 81 years old. As a resident of Gaza, he’s been forced to flee multiple times in recent months. He said: “My hope in 1948 was to return, but my hope today is to survive. I live in such fear.” Because of attempts to rewrite history and to silence Palestinians, Israel’s government is allowed to continue the ongoing Nakba with impunity. For example, the U.S. has skipped and even tried to block prior Nakba Day commemorations at the United Nations. Last year, the Republican Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives tried and failed to cancel a Nakba event at the U.S. Capitol. But we were not silenced: Palestinian Americans who experienced the Nakba firsthand were able to tell their stories of trauma and survival to a packed, standing-room-only audience. **We must continue to ensure that Palestinian voices are heard and acknowledged, not only for healing, but also to create an honest pathway for peace.** The Nakba never ended, as Israel’s government has continued to steal Palestinian land, displace millions of Palestinians, and deny generations of Palestinians the right to live in and even freely visit their homeland. Our country is the largest weapons supplier and funder of Israel’s military, so U.S. residents in particular must speak out against U.S. support for Israel’s genocidal apartheid regime that treats Palestinians as less than human. Supporting this newly re-introduced resolution is one way to keep educating lawmakers and keep the pressure on the U.S. government to stop enabling and unconditionally funding Israel’s human rights abuses. [**Please sign on today to support my resolution in Congress to commemorate the Nakba, which also calls on the United States to continue to support the United Nations Relief and Works Agency (UNRWA) and to support Palestinian refugees’ internationally-recognized legal right to return to their homes.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38YIS_P_YcOYCCdM10KghjstneG3FaY7b1oheSNp7vGenGRnNhT8oPBux4CyerroXwInvoz-F4ZrGZO6brAN0QQBLTY4u4fsW0gCeWirwha10JK0kbvLCO5U8bh8_eOZY2XS1Vj2r_eriTYH-uPYpFhDdTU8E4vgitG_SXIriI7teia13z9EvREWNCIUtKBYeJtFccLagH4AzXCTmqEvEvtwcd7w0ssnLnsMidZfGp_5mVSqcsvkM9Cx6RFXng7rLtg343pIlFsJgttRcfs_aSVQB_ZEEzubhPi-pa9R-ViCno1whXux7xqMde8JWXN-dgl5Xup7HAizcSgT6_cqSJWAjxmRFJP2HHgYQqnIfjVtA/46d/Kyt1tY3QT7iaI-eQ0mv6dQ/h2/h001.RWcsf_6f9yl1KQXLzZS9YEkzkH8Zh-geJBtjgOt956M) Thank you. Together, we will continue demanding an end to genocide, apartheid, and occupation, while building a world where Palestinians and all people can live freely, with human dignity and equal rights for all. Dear Peter,
As I continue to make a strong showing in the polls, the other Presidential candidates are growing very nervous. In response, the other candidates either lash out at me with wild claims or coordinate with their _partners_ in social media to censor me and shadow ban me.
The other candidates know if I have equal access to the digital public square and gain ballot access in all 50 states, _I will be the candidate to beat_.
As I gain ballot access in more and more states – _like Texas just announced_ – the other candidates are using every trick in the book to stop me. But thanks to my supporters, the tricks aren’t working.
Why are they growing more and more worried?
Because I am running a campaign of ideas. It is a campaign based on the values that made us a great nation. My campaign embodies the ideals and the highest values of our nation and our people.
---

---
I have a very clear notion of what this country is supposed to look like.The world still looks to us for leadership. They don’t want a bully or a braggart – they want a leader. And they know the difference.
As President, America will be a moral authority again. We will stop projecting military power abroad and protect and advance economic power at home.
As President, we will rebuild our industrial base and our middle class, the backbone of our country. The entrepreneurial spirit that built our great nation will return and be rewarded under my Presidency.
This is what the American people are longing for and why I am climbing in the polls... _also why the other candidates are growing increasingly worried_.
The election is a mere six months away and we need your support to continue to build on our momentum and get our message out to every American.
I can win this election [but I need your help and support](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=i_can_win_5_15_24_nd1&n=6). clean_body: | | | Whatever you're hearing about the Southern Border, Peter, I can promise you it's 100 times worse. I recently returned from a trip to Arizona where my friend, Rep. Andy Biggs and I talked to several border agents about what needs to be done. | | | | | What I learned is that our agents are exhausted. They're stretched across hundreds of miles with little to no resources from the Biden administration. They're up against coyotes, drug smugglers, human traffickers, gang members, and even terrorists. I'm tired of politicians pontificating about the border crisis. Now's a time for actions and solutions. I'm fighting to be a part of the solution. Thank you, Scott Fitzgerald | | | | | | ---|--- | |

clean_body: Let me explain why we need your help. | I want to share 3 things about how the Jane Fonda Climate PAC Team is fighting the destructive impact of fossil fuels on our environment. After learning about our work, = 1\. Our mission. We have one simple goal: Do what it takes to defeat politicians who are a bit too cozy with the fossil fuel industry and replace them with climate champions at all levels of government. And with fewer than six months until the most important election of our lifetime for climate action, every moment and every action counts more than ever. 2\. We focus our support where we can have the biggest impact. Jane PAC’s electoral strategy leverages grassroots contributions from our supporters to provide direct financial support for candidates, while using Jane’s high profile platforms to reach voters in down-ballot races where even modest support goes a long way. In 2023 alone, we made a significant impact on state and local races across the country, from electing pro-climate majorities in both chambers of Virginia’s state legislature to securing key victories for climate champions in Denver, San Antonio, Chicago, and Pittsburgh. 3\. We are a grassroots-driven organization. Our movement is fueled by people like you, not corporations. Each dollar you’re able to contribute empowers us to advocate for science-backed climate policies, mobilize pro-climate voters in key districts, and support ballot initiatives that aim to reduce carbon emissions and promote renewable energy solutions. Now that you know a little more about what drives the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, = | = = Let’s continue this fight together. xx Jane Fonda = | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 5/15/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi there,
Last night, I was honored to be featured in a new PBS series ["I Am More Than"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) where I talked about how I am MORE THAN just a conservative "politician" - I am a mom, entrepreneur, change-maker, and someone who cares about saving our country for our kids.
In the episode, I share the challenges of overcoming the tragic loss of my first husband and running for governor of Colorado. I also discuss the need for genuine empathy and unity, which are often missing in today's culture. [Tune in here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, May 15, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Colorado ranked as third most dangerous state in new U.S. crime study](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado ranked as one of the ["most dangerous" states](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the U.S. in a new report and it's mostly because of a high rate of property crime.
U.S. News and World Report last week released its 2024 Best States rankings and although Colorado finished in a respectable 16th place overall, it received poor marks for public safety, ranking [No. 3 most dangerous](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
The rankings were determined by factoring both [violent crime and property crime](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) rates in each state using FBI data from 2022, the report said.
"For its part, the FBI notes that numerous factors can affect the amount and type of crime in different areas, including population density, economic conditions, climate and family cohesiveness," [the report](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) said.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Eight measures expected to make November ballot, dozens more possible](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WESTWORD](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado expects [eight ballot measures](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the November election, with more than 60 other initiatives in varying stages of preparation, indicating a highly active political season.
* Measures being considered include legislative proposals to [retain sports betting tax](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for water projects, and citizen initiatives for [economic impact statements](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and a cap on [property tax increases](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Several measures are either undergoing [signature verification](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or are still in the signature collection phase, illustrating a robust civic engagement in the state's legislative process.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rep. Lauren Boebert backs GOP Chairman Dave Williams in 5th District's primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert [endorsed Dave Williams](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for the GOP primary in Colorado's 5th Congressional District, emphasizing that Williams is preferred by the people over other "cranks" in Congress.
* The [primary is a battleground](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between MAGA supporters like Williams, endorsed by Trump and the House Freedom Caucus, and the traditional GOP faction supporting Jeff Crank, backed by House Speaker Mike Johnson and retiring Rep. Doug Lamborn.
* Williams faces accusations of [misusing Colorado GOP resources](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for his campaign, complicating his primary race amidst internal party endorsements for candidates like himself and Boebert in their respective races.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Wolverine reintroduction legislation is'completely opposite' of Colorado's ballot-driven wolf plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's legislature approved a plan for [wolverine reintroduction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), distinct from the state's controversial wolf reintroduction, with a focus on collaboration and federal approval.
* The plan includes [compensation for ranchers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.com/click/e1321942/HZW1haWxfcm9ja3ltb3VudGFpbnZvaWNlX2NvbTI0MDUxNSxuY2xsWGJzZDQsaHR0cHM6L2FodHRwczovL3JvY2t5bW91bnRhaW52b2ljZS5jb20vMjAyNC8wNS93b2x2ZXJpbmUtcmVpbnRyb2R1Y3Rpb24tbGVnaXNsYXRpb24taXMtY29tcGxldGVseS1vcHBvc2l0ZS1vZi1jb2xvcmFkb3MtYmFsbG90LWRyaXZlbi13b2xmLXBsYW4v/seqcf9cef11) for potential livestock losses and no strict deadline for reintroduction, allowing for adaptable management strategies.
* Extensive input from local communities, resort industries, and environmental experts aims to ensure the reintroduction balances ecological goals with economic interests.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Paralegal testifies Manhattan DA Alvin Bragg's office tampered with evidence](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A Manhattan DA's office paralegal testified that [phone records relevant to Donald Trump's case were deleted](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) without informing Trump's legal team, potentially constituting evidence tampering.
* Deleting evidence could be [classified as a felony](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) under New York law, raising serious legal and ethical questions about the conduct of the DA's office.
* These developments occur within the broader context of DA Alvin Bragg's prosecution of Trump for alleged financial misconduct related to payments made to Stormy Daniels, purportedly to influence the [2016 election outcome](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The trial judge limited expert testimony to general information about the Federal Election Commission, excluding broader interpretations relevant to campaign finance that could [benefit Trump's defense](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[COMMENTARY: The greater threat to the planet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_George Will recently wrote a rather chilling column, pointing out something so obvious that it has escaped much attention. That is this: while much of the world is obsessed over climate change, to the point of spending trillions of dollars annually, virtually no attention is being paid to another hypothetical scenario, one that is at least as real in potential (if not more so) as climate change and which bears far more immediate and devastating consequences - that is the threat of nuclear war.
_ _
__Will refers to a book by reporter and historian Annie Jacobsen titled "Nuclear War: A Scenario" in which the author details how a modern-day nuclear exchange could play out - and how quickly - along with the aftermath. The consequences described are every bit as devastating as previously imagined, including the end of civilization as we know it._

Friend, we are closing the curtains...

...On our May Mid-Month fundraising deadline. If we do not hit our goal, we could have to make some serious changes that would limit the likelihood of us winning in November. [**> > That's why I'm reaching out today and humbly asking you for support. <<**](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=3c6c04f912874491bdcb3c86b68db4c6&_e=7C518gV_D_Rftxtda87av3AOXKtinACdxYUkB164NO3Vo6obiBrweNEKMxTqeoHkD1ZPW6ekFiCU3PXekIenQjzDhBXTEsIqv3xTRM7lhOjqGkhQUjpYFHVLmX2eJ2ozfiwJdfP4hTxMkVFDEFNE5gBt6i5pGtztlZwfLZ4R70JDiaQgo67x3lN2p2Q8xfXDj9mSwe6K81BBWE-XeOuTplWgLHuCW6sqMRIvBDDiZmssq35-DaGVSo88YkKYCWEJ3Mc7dcNvCA5RaKpq9D7R1am5q9qWRnYkJV-W2erRK1k_vJUOLObgRQnS2NZiPOXuZkAPQ1QRKPUtdvSfPei6eg%3D%3D)
The truth is...this could be the last email you ever get from me. I want to be honest with you because far too many leaders in our country have lost the ability to do so.

Please keep reading until the end.

**The odds are stacked against us right now, but your support could change everything.**

My name is Jim Banks. If you haven't heard of me, I'm an Afghanistan veteran from Indiana now serving in Congress.

[](http://links.banksforsenate.com/u/click?_t=588630feb05642bf856633600a62821b&_m=3c6c04f912874491bdcb3c86b68db4c6&_e=7C518gV_D_Rftxtda87av3AOXKtinACdxYUkB164NO3Vo6obiBrweNEKMxTqeoHkD1ZPW6ekFiCU3PXekIenQjzDhBXTEsIqv3xTRM7lhOjqGkhQUjpYFHVLmX2eJ2ozfiwJdfP4hTxMkVFDEFNE5gBt6i5pGtztlZwfLZ4R70JaYPjRLiBfwTvDt3_bsv6oHVdvaGxpdfex8OO8l7NUiOjgA9ZCivz7ehk6Um73qgrHYfNBKM-P_J3uEzBAUE-XDj6EifQiCwc-bSF9XVX5qYAKW31syRcCU_he0-_VmKfYTH4fbea-JxH6e6QzktUo5GKH_aWrsSyaELgSYalOoQ%3D%3D)
I worked hard to serve my community alongside my wife, Amanda. And above all, I am a father to three amazing girls.

> ---
> **Setting up a strong organizing and outreach plan comes with many costs.**
>
> Here’s a breakdown of the categories we’re focusing on going into the summer:
> **Polling** – national polling struggles to tell the complete story, but targeted polling in key political geographies (like the Philly suburbs!) gives us a more nuanced, more granular understanding of the electoral climate.
>
> _How are independent voters feeling about a Biden-Trump rematch? Are undecided voters leaning a particular way? How many might skip November’s election entirely?_ Polling will help us answer these questions – and we need this information to target our field efforts effectively.
> **[Donate to fund polling costs>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85030057/473416025/120714406?amount=25&refcode=05152024_md_mmfr_fr_3&refcode2=5b7aca65-0f13-ef11-96f3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YjdhY2E2NS0wZjEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Retqw7VJ-Ix87D6NUrysw-FeBOqwK3z-ImQod43v_XU=)**
> * * *
> **Printing materials** – we have volunteers, staff, and partner organizations/campaigns ready to help us reach voters – and that means we need to print palm cards, yard signs, buttons, and more to amplify our message. Folks who receive printed materials from a campaign are more likely both to get involved _and_ to vote. And we need to turn out voters for races up-and-down the ballot – which means we’ll be going through a lot of printed materials!

>

Here’s a breakdown of the categories we’re focusing on going into the summer: Polling – national polling struggles to tell the complete story, but targeted polling in key political geographies (like the Philly suburbs!) gives us a more nuanced, more granular understanding of the electoral climate. How are independent voters feeling about a Biden-Trump rematch? Are undecided voters leaning a particular way? How many might skip November’s election entirely? Polling will help us answer these questions – and we need this information to target our field efforts effectively. = Printing materials – we have volunteers, staff, and partner organizations/campaigns ready to help us reach voters – and that means we need to print palm cards, yard signs, buttons, and more to amplify our message. Folks who receive printed materials from a campaign are more likely both to get involved and to vote. And we need to turn out voters for races up-and-down the ballot – which means we’ll be going through a lot of printed materials! = --- Strategizing around our budget allows us to be intentional about our ground game here in the Philly suburbs, and we’re counting on the strength and tenacity of this grassroots team to help us bring a blue wave to PA this November. I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important – = Warmly and with my thanks, Madeleine = Madeleine is an attorney, professor, mother, grandmother, and Member of Congress, representing Pennsylvania’s 4th Congressional District of Berks and Montgomery Counties. She is an outspoken leader who champions progressive priorities such as education, universal access to healthcare, gun safety, and ethical government.Madeleine Dean has built a reputation for getting things done, and we need her to continue to be our voice to serve us in Congress. MAGA Republicans have Big Oil money in their corner, but we have something even stronger -- we have YOU and thousands more committed environmentalists who know that our climate and future is on the line in 2024. And by taking action today, we can make sure that MILLIONS of pro-environment voters turn out in November to send pro-polluter politicians packing.

From now until Election Day, LCV Victory Fund will be communicating with voters in battleground states about the stakes and the extreme peril of having Donald Trump, his MAGA acolytes, and Big Oil cronies back in office. And **we 'll be working to elect pro-climate, pro-democracy candidates up and down the ballot** to the House, Senate, and White House.

3. **We must test and launch hard-hitting broadcast and digital advertising** in states and districts where our message can have the most impact.

| **[**TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

LCV Victory Fund knows how to defeat politicians who consistently side with Big Polluters, and to deliver victory to environmental and climate champions. We have a long record of success helping to elect hundreds of leaders who are fighting for the environment.

But as things stand, our 2024 campaigns are still underfunded. And it's the investments we make _right now_ that will make the most impact in November.****

**Please, don 't sit this out and miss the opportunity to help pro-climate leaders WIN this election.** [We can defeat Trump and his Big Oil allies who will overturn climate action, but not without your help. Please rush a contribution to LCV Victory Fund today. Remember -- right now, all gifts will be matched 3x >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fbX-)

The future of our planet is riding on what each of us does today.

Pete Maysmith

If you're able, then please follow this link to chip in and help me defend Democratic Senate control in 2024.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85031102/473419744/-1845622715?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk287-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZjJkZDM3MS0xNDEzLWVmMTEtOTZmMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Wq4nhTYPR2l5Xjf026NRZCvmQAhYYNfpu0xXBF2OUQ=)**
